Leadership mentality and willingness to take ownership

Your sales experience and how many years you have worked in sales

Any experience working with a cleaning or home-service company

Your experience with BookingKoala and/or GoHighLevel

Your current availability



Please also include a short voice recording introducing yourself and describing your sales experience.

title: Full-Time Residential Construction Estimator (US Contractor)
description:
I own a home improvement, remodeling, and real estate investment company in New Jersey, USA, and I’m looking for a dedicated, full-time estimator to be a long-term part of my team. This is a work-from-home role with room to grow as we grow.



WHAT YOU’LL DO:



 • Read residential construction plans and remodel drawings, and write a clear scope of work for each job

 • Produce detailed quantity takeoffs and material lists by trade (flooring, paint, drywall, doors, roofing, bathrooms, etc.), and include LABOR in every takeoff, applying labor rates so each estimate reflects both material and labor cost (per square foot, per door, per linear foot of trim, etc.)

 • Build estimates two ways: (1) from full plan sets, and (2) from detailed walkthrough videos where I provide the measurements and scope for you to price

 • Apply and help build out my pricing. I have rates for some items, but not all. For the rest, I’ll give you old plans plus old signed contracts showing what I charged, and I want you to reverse-engineer my rates from them (example: from a past job’s total painting price plus the square footage, trim, and doors painted, work backward to find my painting rate)

 • As part of estimating, build and maintain a list of subcontractors by trade (demo, framing, plumbing, electrical, roofing, siding). You’ll be their point of contact —
 them our plans, request pricing, answer questions, and gather quotes to fold into the estimate

 • Flag anything missing or unclear before it becomes a problem



YOU’RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:



 • Have real residential construction estimating / quantity takeoff experience

 • Are comfortable using digital takeoff and estimating software — tell me what you use

 • Think like an estimator: you catch what’s missing, not just measure what’s shown

 • Are organized, dependable, and communicate clearly in English (written and spoken)

 • Have reliable internet and can work my full business hours on US Eastern time (this means a night shift if you’re based in the Philippines)

 • Want a stable, long-term job with one employer, not short gigs



TO APPLY:



 1. Start your reply with “Blueprint Ready” so I know you actually read this.

 2. Tell me honestly — is this work you’re comfortable doing? You’d be taking my blueprints and turning them into estimates, and taking my walkthrough videos and measurements and turning those into estimates too. How comfortable are you with both, and what estimating software do you use?

 3. If we move forward, part of how I’ll evaluate you is a sample estimate you’ll do for me. We’ll also meet over Zoom — you must be able to speak clear English.

title: SENIOR MARKETING MANAGER — LIFECYCLE & CAMPAIGNS
description:
Lux & Nyx | Full-time | Remote | Reports to CEO (Lisa) | Overlaps U.S. Central business hours | Long-term





ABOUT LUX & NYX



Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. We've been featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's. We're a small, remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu. We move fast. We build systems that compound. We hire people who can think and ship.





THE ROLE



You'll own L&N's marketing calendar and the campaigns that run through it — with Klaviyo as your primary channel. This is an execution-forward role with real strategic depth: you take campaign concepts set with Lisa and our designer, build them into campaigns, ship them, read the data, and iterate.



You're not a coordinator. You're not a head of growth. You're the marketing manager who actually runs the calendar — building, launching, measuring, refining. The big creative concepts come from the founder and creative lead; you're the person who turns them into a running, measurable program.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Campaign execution and calendar — turn campaign concepts (set with Lisa and our designer) into shipped campaigns: seasonal 
nts, product launches, promotional pushes. You own the sequence, timing, dependencies, and copy iteration to ship on time and on brand. Draft and manage the working marketing calendar 6-8 weeks ahead, and surface slips before they become fires.

- Klaviyo execution (primary channel) — build and launch Klaviyo campaigns and flows: welcome, post-purchase, abandoned cart, browse, win-back, VIP, and the review-generation system that lives inside the lifecycle (post-purchase
 + packaging insert touchpoints). Audit what's underperforming, rebuild it, A/B test, iterate. Just as critical: grow the list — popup optimization, post-purchase opt-in, and list hygiene are part of this job, not someone else's problem.

- Performance analytics — live in the data: revenue per recipient, subscriber growth rate, flow attribution, open rate, click rate, conversion rate. Read it, interpret it, and change what you ship next based on what it tells you.

- Cross-channel coordination — connect the dots between DTC,
, Amazon, and retail 
nts so a launch or seasonal push lands everywhere it needs to.

- Tactical paid testing (secondary) — run small paid test budgets to drive controlled traffic for conversion-rate testing, asset performance, and PDP optimization. This is a testing instrument, not an acquisition channel — paid acquisition scaling, when it happens, will be handled by an outsourced expert who works from your learnings.

- Systems and SOPs — keep one source of truth, and document every recurring process into a short SOP so the work never lives in one person's head.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- 4-6 years in marketing — ideally DTC e-commerce, lifecycle marketing, or brand marketing.

- Hands-on Klaviyo — you've built (not just managed) campaigns and flows that drove real revenue. This is the heart of the role.

- Small-list builder — bonus if you've taken a Klaviyo program from under 25K subscribers and grown it materially, or built the foundation flows on a brand at our stage. We want builders, not optimizers of someone else's mature program.

- Executor with brand sensibility — you take direction well, recognize good copy from generic, and iterate fast (with AI tooling support) until it lands.

- Data literate — CTR, conversion rate, and revenue per send aren't intimidating. You read them and act on them.

- Comfortable reading CTR and conversion concepts across channels, not just
 — you can interpret Meta Ads metrics, design a basic test campaign, and read the results. (You won't be the paid acquisition lead; you'll use paid as a testing tool.)

- Strong copy execution — you can write a clean
 brief, iterate copy in the L&N voice (with AI tooling support), and ship work that feels intentional, not generic.

- Comfortable in async, remote, founder-led environments, with meaningful overlap with U.S. Central business hours.

- AI-native preferred — you've built workflows where AI compresses your time: tools, prompts, verification habits. (Strongly preferred, not required.)

- DTC brand-side experience strongly preferred over agency-side.

- Here for the long haul — someone who wants to own this work and get great at it.





WHAT SEPARATES GREAT FROM GOOD



- Thinks in systems, not tasks — designs the campaign and the calendar that runs after it.

- Owns the metric — when someone asks "how's
 performing?" you have the answer before they finish the question.

- Ships campaigns that feel intentional — through tight execution, brand sensibility, and copy iteration, not necessarily original concepts.

- Owns the brief once it's set — drives every dependency to ship on time and on brand.

- Comfortable with ambiguity — early-stage brand, things shift, you adapt.





HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



This is small-list stage, so the metrics are calibrated for the actual job — building the asset while pulling revenue out of it. We won't score you against benchmarks that assume a list you don't have yet. Targets calibrate quarterly.



- Net new
 subscribers per month — growing the asset; calibrated with you after the first 30 days.

- Foundation flow revenue (welcome, abandoned cart, browse, post-purchase) — measurable attributable revenue from the top 4 flows within 90 days.

- Revenue per recipient on campaigns — $0.10-$0.30 (DTC fashion benchmark).

- Organic review rate (rolling 12-month) — growing meaningfully as the review system matures.

- DTC conversion rate (assist) — trending up quarter over quarter.

- Engagement health — open rate at or above 35%, click rate at or above 3%, unsubscribe under 0.5%.

- Execution discipline — on-time campaign launch at or above 95%, QA accuracy at or above 99%.





HOW WE WORK TOGETHER



Cadence is intentional, decision rights are clear, and you have real autonomy to ship inside agreed scope.



- Weekly team sync (1 hour) — campaign health, calendar status, what's at risk.

- Monday 1:1 with Lisa (30 min) — priorities, blockers, decisions needed.

- Quarterly planning with Lisa and our creative lead — themes, major 
nts, KPI targets.

- Async-first via Slack — decisions documented, same-day response expected on blockers.

- Klaviyo consulting agency on retainer — you have access to a senior Klaviyo advisor for tricky architecture decisions, deliverability issues, and best-practice gut-checks. You drive the work; they're your expert backstop.



You can ship without approval: copy iterations, A/B tests, flow optimizations, calendar adjustments inside the approved quarter, and small paid tests.



You need Lisa's approval for: net-new campaigns or flows, calendar additions outside the approved quarter, larger paid tests, and anything that introduces a new brand-voice angle or net-new customer touchpoint.





COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Competitive compensation tied to experience and location, plus performance bonuses tied to KPIs. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Maternity leave. Remote-first culture with intentional async work.





HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word LIFECYCLE, and in three sentences tell us about an
 flow or campaign you built from the ground up and the revenue it drove — what you built, how you measured it, and what you changed after reading the data. Then attach your resume. Applications that skip either step won't be read.



That first line is deliberate: it's how we see, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and whether you think in terms of what you built and what it earned — not just tasks you completed.





ABOUT THE TEAM



We're a small, remote-first team. We run on weekly syncs, Monday 1:1s, and quarterly goal-setting during U.S. Central business hours. LATAM time zones overlap naturally; PH candidates should expect a U.S.-hours schedule. We lead before we're asked. We think from the customer's perspective. We grow with intention. We think deeply before we act. If that's how you work too, we'd love to meet you.

title: Business Development Research & Outreach Specialist – Global Technology
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Philippines



Are you ridiculously good at finding people online?



Give you the name of a technology company and you can find the right decision-maker, their LinkedIn profile, their contact details, who handles their PR — and probably what conference they’re attending next.



You enjoy research. You’re organized. You’re persistent. And when someone doesn’t respond to your first message, you don’t simply send “just following up.”



We should talk.

____



About NettResults

NettResults is an international communications agency working with technology companies around the world.

For more than 25 years, we’ve helped global technology brands build their reputation, enter new markets and grow internationally.

We work with major technology companies and with a global network of partner agencies across the Middle East, North America, Europe and Asia.

We’re now looking for someone to help us find and develop the opportunities we know are out there.

____



The Role



This is not primarily a sales-closing role.

You’ll work directly with our founder and support our international business development.

Your job is to find the right companies, identify the right people, start conversations and make sure opportunities don’t disappear because nobody followed up.



You’ll:



* Research technology companies and potential partners

* Identify CEOs, CMOs, communications leaders and other decision-makers

* Find accurate contact information

* Research which PR/marketing agencies represent target companies

* Build targeted prospect lists

* Reach out through
, LinkedIn and telephone

* Follow up intelligently and consistently

* Book qualified introductory meetings

* Keep our CRM accurate and up to date

* Track opportunities and next actions

* Support the CEO with business-development research



Some prospects will be completely cold.

Others will be companies or agency partners where NettResults already has a relationship.

Knowing the difference — and approaching them accordingly — matters.



You’ll Probably Love This Job If…



You can disappear down a research rabbit hole and emerge with exactly the information someone asked for.

You enjoy figuring things out.

You’re naturally organized.

You notice details other people miss.

You’re comfortable picking up the telephone.

You can write a short, natural
 without making it sound like a marketing campaign.

You follow up without needing to be reminded.

And when someone says, “Can you find out who handles PR for this company?” your instinct is: “Leave it with me.”

____



Experience We’re Looking For

Experience in some combination of:

* B2B lead generation

* Business development

* Sales research

* LinkedIn prospecting

* Appointment setting

* CRM management

* Technology companies

* International clients



Experience with tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay, HubSpot, Copper or similar platforms is useful.

But we’re much more interested in how you think and work than how many software logos you can put on a résumé.

Excellent written and spoken English is essential.

____



One Important Point

We previously advertised a broader business-development position at NettResults.

If you applied for that role and you’re now reading this thinking:

“Actually, THIS sounds much more like me.”

Apply again — and tell us.

We have deliberately separated the roles because we’re looking for different strengths.

____



How to Apply



Keep it simple.

Do not send us an essay.

We already have the job description. We want to learn about you.



In your application, answer these five questions. Maximum 2–3 sentences per answer.



1. What’s the best piece of business information you’ve ever managed to find online that wasn’t easy to find?

Tell us what you were looking for and how you found it.



2. What’s your actual experience with outbound prospecting?

Give us approximate numbers:
s, LinkedIn outreach or calls per day/week, who you were contacting, and what you were trying to achieve.



3. Telephone: love it, tolerate it, or avoid it? Why?

There is a correct answer for you. We want the real one.



4. What CRM and prospecting tools have you personally used regularly?

Only list tools you’ve actually used yourself.



5. Research task:

Identify one named technology company NettResults has publicly stated it has worked with.



Tell us:

Company name | CEO’s name - Who you believe we probably worked with—and their personal
 address and linkedIn profile.



Put the CEO’s surname as the FIRST WORD of your application.



That’s it.

No cover letter required.

No long explanation of why you’re passionate about business development.



If your answers make us curious, the next stage will be a short practical research exercise based on the kind of work you’d actually do at NettResults.



We’re looking forward to meeting you.

 and SMS communication?• Business phone integrations?• Website lead integration?• Appointment scheduling?• Document collection and organization?• Internal task management?• Team assignments?• Client communication history?• Payment and invoice tracking?• Notifications and reminders?• Reporting dashboards?• KPI tracking?• Forms and intake processes?• User roles and permissions?• Workflow automations?• Credit-service workflows?• Business funding workflows?• Business operations workflows

We want someone who can understand how our business operates and help us determine where technology and automation can make it better.

CRM + Automation Experience

We are especially interested in candidates with experience using platforms and tools such as:

• GoHighLevel?• HubSpot?• Zoho?• Salesforce?• Zapier?• Make?• Google Workspace?• Twilio or similar phone/SMS systems?•
 integrations?• Payment processors?• Website forms?• Calendars and scheduling systems?• APIs and webhooks

You do NOT need experience with every platform listed.

We care more about whether you understand CRM architecture, databases, workflows, automation, integrations, permissions and scalability.

Scalability Is VERY Important

We are not building our CRM only for today’s needs.

Our long-term goal is to develop a strong core business system that can eventually be replicated, customized and implemented for other U.S.-based business clients as an additional service.

We therefore need someone who understands how to build with scalability in mind from the beginning.

Our goal is to eventually be able to:

• Create standardized CRM templates?• Replicate systems efficiently for new businesses?• Customize pipelines and workflows by industry?• Maintain separate client accounts, users and data?• Connect each client’s
, phone, website, calendar and lead sources?• Create industry-specific automations?• Deploy new client systems without rebuilding everything from scratch?• Maintain and improve systems as our client base grows

Potential industries may include:

• Trucking & transportation?• Real estate/property management?• Professional services?• Credit and financial-service businesses?• Other small businesses

Experience building SaaS, white-label, agency, multi-account or repeatable CRM systems is a major PLUS.

We Want Your Technical Input

We are not looking for someone who simply says yes to every request.

We want someone who can tell us:

“This can be automated.”

“There is a better way to build this.”

“This will cause problems when you scale.”

“This platform would be better for what you’re trying to accomplish.”

“This feature already exists—we don’t need to custom-build it.”

We value someone who thinks strategically and can explain technical decisions in simple language.

Ownership, Access & Documentation

This is extremely important to us.

Our company must maintain appropriate administrative access and control over its business systems and data.

We expect:

• Company administrator access where technically available?• Clear identification of every third-party platform being used?• Transparent licensing and recurring software costs?• Secure credential management?• Documentation of workflows and automations?• Documentation of APIs, webhooks and integrations?• Clear explanation of where company/client data is stored?• Clear ownership/licensing terms established before development begins?• Reasonable technical handoff documentation?• A system another qualified developer could maintain if necessary?• No intentional vendor lock-in or undisclosed dependencies

We WANT a long-term developer relationship.

However, our company cannot be dependent on one individual having exclusive access to critical business infrastructure.

Scope & Pricing Transparency

We understand that legitimate new features and major changes can require additional development time and compensation.

We simply expect transparency.

Before major work begins, we expect agreement regarding:

• What is included?• What is not included?• Expected development time?• Pricing or hourly expectations?• Third-party software costs?• What would constitute additional scope

Additional billable work should be discussed and approved BEFORE it is completed.

Who We’re Looking For

You may be an excellent fit if you:

• Have professional CRM development experience?• Understand CRM/database architecture?• Have built advanced automations?• Understand APIs and webhooks?• Have experience with integrations?• Understand permissions and data security?• Think about scalability before building?• Document your work?• Communicate clearly?• Can troubleshoot independently?• Are comfortable challenging an idea when there is a better solution?• Have experience supporting U.S.-based companies?• Want to build something long-term rather than complete random projects

Experience with GoHighLevel Agency/SaaS systems, multi-client CRM architecture or white-label CRM deployment is especially valuable.

Long-Term Opportunity

Our vision extends beyond maintaining one CRM.

We are building a broader business ecosystem involving:

Business Credit ? Business Funding ? Business Systems ? CRM ? Managed Business Operations ? Growth

As this develops, the right person could eventually have the opportunity to:

• Become our lead CRM/systems developer?• Help create standardized client CRM systems?• Build industry-specific templates?• Develop automations used across multiple businesses?• Help onboard new business clients?• Help train future technical tea
mbers?• Oversee CRM implementation and technical support?• Help us continually improve our technology infrastructure

We are looking for someone who wants to grow WITH the company.

How to Apply

Please answer ALL questions below.

How many years have you professionally worked with CRM systems?

Which CRM platforms have you personally built or customized?

Describe the most complex CRM or automation system you have personally built.

Do you have experience with GoHighLevel? If yes, please describe exactly what you have built.

Have you worked with GoHighLevel Agency accounts, SaaS Mode, sub-accounts or similar multi-client CRM architecture?

Which automation platforms do you use?

Do you have experience with APIs and webhooks? Give us one real example.

Have you integrated websites,
, SMS, business phones, calendars, payment processors or lead sources into a CRM?

Have you ever built a CRM system that was replicated across multiple businesses or client accounts?

How would you structure a CRM today if you knew we eventually wanted to deploy versions of it to 50+ businesses?

How do you document your work so another qualified developer could maintain the system?

How do you handle requests that fall outside an originally agreed project scope?

Are you comfortable providing our company appropriate administrator access to systems developed for us?

Have you previously worked with U.S.-based businesses?

Are you currently working for other clients or employers? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?

How many hours per week are you available?

What is your desired hourly or monthly rate?

Are you looking for a long-term position?

Please provide examples, screenshots, Loom videos or a portfolio showing CRM systems and automations YOU personally built.

Final Scenario

A business receives leads from its website, social media, phone calls and referrals.

The owner wants every lead automatically entered into one CRM, categorized by lead source, assigned to the appropriate tea
mber, automatically followed up with, moved through a sales pipeline and included in a weekly report showing leads, appointments, conversions and revenue.

Briefly explain how you would design this system and which tools you would consider using.

Please begin your application with the word SYSTEMS so we know you read the entire posting.

We are excited to find someone who wants to help us build something substantial and grow with us long-term.

title: AI-Native Research & Operations Assistant — Research, Excel, BD & Executive Support
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an unusually capable, curious, and AI-native generalist to work directly with two professionals based in the United States.



This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant role focused mainly on calendar management or data entry.



We are looking for someone who can operate across a very wide range of work — from serious business research, spreadsheet analysis, and business-development support to personal logistics and administrative tasks.



The common thread is simple:



We want someone who can take an idea, question, or objective and intelligently move it toward completion with as little management overhead as possible.



We expect to begin at approximately 10 hours per week, with significant potential to increase the role over time if the ROI and working relationship are strong.



WHAT YOU MAY WORK ON



RESEARCH & ANALYSIS



* Research industries, companies, technologies, markets, competitors, and business opportunities

* Identify experts, founders, executives, potential customers, or other people we should speak with

* Produce concise research briefs with sources, conclusions, uncertainties, and recommendations

* Compare products, services, vendors, travel options, professional services, etc.

* Turn messy information into clear and useful conclusions



EXCEL / GOOGLE SHEETS / QUANTITATIVE WORK



* Build and maintain spreadsheets

* Clean and organize datasets

* Create formulas, lookups, pivots, scenarios, and simple financial/business models

* Use AI to accelerate spreadsheet work while checking that the underlying logic and numbers are correct



BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & OUTREACH



* Research prospects and build targeted lists

* Help operate tools such as Apollo and CRMs

* Enrich and segment prospect data

* Draft thoughtful, personalized outreach

* Manage follow-ups and help schedule calls

* Maintain organized pipelines and report on progress



EXECUTIVE & PERSONAL OPERATIONS



* Research and book appointments

* Arrange gifts and cards

* Order groceries or household items

* Research travel and logistics

* Handle online purchases, reservations, comparisons, follow-ups, and administrative tasks

* Solve miscellaneous problems that arise in our work and personal lives



THE RANGE OF THE ROLE



We genuinely mean the range above.



On the same day, you might:



* Research an emerging technology market

* Build a spreadsheet model

* Identify prospective business contacts

* Draft outreach

* Arrange a birthday gift

* Place a grocery order



We are looking for someone who is comfortable with all of it.



No task should feel “beneath” you, and complex work should not intimidate you.



AI-NATIVE WORKING STYLE



AI fluency is an important part of this role.



We are not looking for someone who simply says they “know ChatGPT.”



We want someone who naturally thinks about how AI and modern software can help them complete work faster and better.



You should already be comfortable with tools such as:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* Perplexity

* Or similar AI products



Depending on the task, you might use AI for:



* Research

* Synthesis

* Drafting

* Spreadsheet formulas

* Data transformation

* Workflow design

* Troubleshooting

* Automating repetitive work



Familiarity with tools such as Apollo, HubSpot, Zapier, Make, n8n, Clay, Notion, Airtable, or similar tools is a bonus.



We do NOT expect one candidate to already know everything.



More important is your ability to learn new software quickly and intelligently d
 when to use:



* AI

* Automation

* Traditional research

* Manual work

* Human judgment



We care about the quality and accuracy of the output — not whether you completed something manually.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You are likely a strong fit if you:



* Have excellent written and spoken English

* Are highly resourceful

* Are comfortable figuring things out independently

* Are a strong internet researcher

* Are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets

* Have strong attention to detail

* Communicate clearly and concisely

* Use AI extensively and thoughtfully

* Can distinguish reliable sources from unreliable information

* Verify important information instead of blindly trusting AI

* Are comfortable with ambiguity

* Can make reasonable assumptions and keep moving

* Know when you can proceed independently and when you genuinely need clarification

* Are comfortable doing both analytical work and mundane administrative work

* Have no problem switching between serious research and something simple like ordering groceries

* Are curious about business, technology, and how things work

* Want to become increasingly capable over time rather than simply execute a fixed checklist



Experience in any of the following could be relevant:



* Research

* Operations

* Executive assistance

* Business development

* Lead generation

* Consulting

* Finance

* Startups

* Data analysis



TECHNICAL COMFORT



You do NOT need to be a software engineer.



However, technical comfort is a major plus.



For example, we would love someone who may not be a programmer but is comfortable using AI to help:



* Write a small script

* Manipulate data

* Understand an API

* Troubleshoot a workflow

* Connect tools together

* Solve a technical problem independently



The important thing is not whether you already know how to do everything.



It is whether you are comfortable figuring things out.



HOW WE EXPECT THE ROLE TO EVOLVE



Initially, we will give you relatively defined assignments while we learn how we work together.



Over time, our goal is for you to progress from:



“Do this task” to “Figure this out" to “Own this outcome”



An exceptional person in this role should eventually:



* Notice recurring work

* Propose better processes

* Build lightweight systems

* Use AI and automation where appropriate

* Anticipate useful next steps

* Reduce the amount of coordination required from us

* Become increasingly trusted with open-ended outcomes



There is substantial opportunity for the role, hours, responsibility, and compensation to grow for someone exceptional.



HOURS & COMPENSATION



* Starting commitment: approximately 10 hours/week

* Potential to increase meaningfully over time

* Compensation: $10–18 USD/hour depending on experience and ability

* Long-term relationship preferred

* Paid trial work will be part of the hiring process



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the questions below in your application.



We care much more about thoughtful answers than a generic cover letter.



1. Tell us briefly about your background and why this particular role interests you.

2. Which AI tools do you currently use regularly?



Give us 2 specific examples of real work you completed substantially faster or better because of AI.



Please explain what you actually did rather than simply listing tools.



3. Describe the most difficult research project you have completed.



What was the question, how did you research it, and what did you ultimately deliver?



4. Rate your Excel / Google Sheets ability from 1–10 and briefly explain what you can actually do.



Please mention formulas, pivots, models, data cleaning, or other relevant capabilities.



5. Tell us about any experience you have with lead generation, Apollo, CRMs, outbound sales, prospect research, or business development.

6. Tell us about a time someone gave you an unclear or underspecified objective and you had to figure out how to accomplish it yourself.

7. Imagine you have spent 45 minutes researching something using AI and then discover that one of the important claims the AI gave you may be wrong.



What would you do?



8. This role might involve researching a complex business or technology question in the morning and arranging a grocery order, gift, or appointment later that day.



How do you feel about that range of work?



9. What hourly compensation are you looking for?

10. How many hours per week are you currently available, and what other ongoing work commitments do you have?



IMPORTANT



Please do not send a generic AI-generated cover letter.



Using AI to help you think, research, or improve your writing is completely fine — in fact, we encourage intelligent AI use.



But we want your answers to reflect your actual experience and thinking.



Candidates who appear to be a strong fit will be invited to complete a short screening exercise.



Finalists will be invited to complete a paid practical assessment and interview.

title: Book Typesetter / Formatter — Print + EPUB
description:
We are looking for an experienced Book Typesetter / Formatter to help prepare a professionally edited nonfiction manuscript for publication.



The project requires both a 6 × 9 paperback interior and a reflowable EPUB 3 suitable for major ebook platforms.



What You'll Do



Typeset and format the complete paperback interior

Create a clean, professional literary nonfiction layout

Apply consistent typography, styles, headings, page numbering, and spacing

Format references, citations, quotations, and back matter

Prepare a print-ready PDF for print-on-demand

Create a properly structured, reflowable EPUB 3

Ensure EPUB navigation, links, metadata, and heading hierarchy are correct

Validate the EPUB using EPUBCheck

Review proofs and make production corrections

Provide editable source files and final production files



Design Direction



We are looking for a design that feels:



Elegant • Literary • Intelligent • Warm • Contemporary • Authoritative



The layout should prioritize readability and the writing itself. We are not looking for highly decorative, self-help-style, or overly designed interiors.



The project already has an established typography and layout direction that the selected contractor will be expected to follow.



Requirements



You should have:

Proven experience typesetting professionally published books

At least 3 relevant nonfiction book interiors in your portfolio

Experience with 6 × 9 trade paperback formatting

Experience preparing files for KDP or other print-on-demand platforms

Strong experience creating reflowable EPUBs

Experience with EPUBCheck and ebook testing

Professional book-layout software, preferably Adobe InDesign

Strong attention to typography, spacing, pagination, and detail

Ability to provide editable source files

Excellent communication and revision management skills



This is a production/typesetting role, not a copyediting role. The manuscript will be provided as a finalized master file. Any apparent text issues should be flagged for review rather than changed independently.



Project Timeline



The project is on a relatively tight production schedule, with a target publication date in September 2026.



The selected contractor should be available to begin shortly after appointment and remain available through proofing and final production.



To Apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph.



In your application, please include:

Your resume

3+ examples of relevant book interiors

2+ EPUB examples or retailer links, if available

The software and workflow you use

Your experience with print-on-demand and EPUB production

Your fixed project fee and what it includes

Your estimated turnaround time

Confirmation that you can provide editable source files



Please begin your application with “BOOK TYPESETTER” so we know you have read the posting.



We are looking for someone who combines strong typographic judgment, technical production skills, attention to detail, and reliability. Portfolio quality will be a major factor in our selection.

title: Google Ads Expert
description:
We're looking for an AI-first Google Ads expert who genuinely loves this work and shows up with the plan. If you light up when you're building a Search or PMax campaign from scratch, use AI as a daily working partner, and prefer driving strategy over taking tasks, we'd love to hear from you.



The Role



- You'll build and manage multiple Google Ads (and Microsoft Ads) accounts from the ground up, across both ecommerce and lead generation clients.

- Most of the work lives in Search and Performance Max, with other campaign types layered in when the account calls for it.

- You'll partner with our team to win. We share the wins and we share the work, but you'll lead the thinking on the accounts you own.

- Success in your first 30 to 60 days looks like you showing up with the plan. You're telling us what we should be testing, why, and when. You have a clear point of view on what's working across each account, what isn't, and what you want to try next. The bar is strategic ownership.



Schedule



You'll work part-time hours that fall somewhere between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST. We'll set the exact schedule together. There's a real path to full-time as the work grows, so we'd love to know you're open to that conversation down the road. Just want to make sure you can work somewhere inside that window.



What We're Looking For



- An AI-first mindset. You use AI as a real working partner every day, and it shows in how you work.

- Independent problem-solving. You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before sending anything off.

- A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be doing, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- Deep comfort in Google Ads, GA4, and Search Console. You can navigate them without thinking and read the data without guessing.

- Experience running paid search across both ecommerce and lead generation. Both motions are part of the work, so you should be confident in each.

- A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order.



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.



2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.



3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). These ones we already know we need.

- Google Ads /10

- GA4 /10



Then add every other tool you use, one per line, with a /10. Include Microsoft Ads if you've used it, AI tools, spreadsheets you've built, niche platforms, the works. Honesty matters more than scoring high. The video will give us a sense of where you actually are.



4. Walk us through your work history. For your last 2 or 3 clients or accounts.

- What size was the account when you started (ad spend, revenue, lead volume, whatever metric fits the role)?

- What did you do for them?

- What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

- If you have current clients, where are those accounts today?



We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better.



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a task in Google Ads where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you took over a Google Ads account on day one for an ecommerce or lead gen client, walk us through what you'd want to look at in your first week and what your first hypothesis to test would be.



2. Walk us through how you'd diagnose a Search campaign that's spending well but not converting. What do you check, in what order, and why?



3. Tell us about a time you disagreed with a client or stakeholder about how a Google Ads account should be structured. What did you push back on, how did you handle it, and what happened?



4. Why do you love this work? Tell us about a recent campaign or 
nt that reminded you why you do it.



5. What's changed about how you structure and signal Google Ads campaigns in the last 12 months (PMax asset groups, search themes, AI Max for Search, broad match plus smart bidding, whatever you've adjusted to)? What's working for you right now and what isn't?

title: SaaS Operations & Client Success Specialist — Cemetery Intelligence
description:
# SaaS Operations & Client Success Specialist — Cemetery Intelligence



**Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote**

**$5–$10 USD/hour + Client Acquisition Bonuses**



We are building a new technology-enabled intelligence service for cemetery businesses in the United States and are looking for a smart, highly capable person to help operate it, improve it, and grow with us.



This is NOT a traditional virtual assistant role.



It is also NOT purely a programming role.



We are looking for someone who combines:



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong judgment and problem-solving

* Customer-service ability

* Curiosity and attention to detail

* Comfort with data and technology

* Ability to learn new systems quickly

* Professionalism and reliability



## What Is Cemetery Intelligence?



Cemeteries can have years or decades of burial records, ownership records, monument information, photographs, customer files, and operational data.



Important information can easily become buried inside those systems.



Our goal is to help cemetery operators identify important exceptions, inconsistencies, opportunities, and unfinished items that might otherwise go unnoticed.



Examples may include:



* Recent burials with no permanent monument recorded

* Records that disagree between different systems

* Possible memorial or inscription opportunities

* Missing photos or documentation

* Work that may not have been properly completed or recorded

* Ownership or customer information requiring investigation



Your job will be to help turn raw information into useful, verified, actionable intelligence.



## What You Will Do



### Cemetery Intelligence Operations



You may:



* Review cemetery records and datasets

* Compare information from multiple sources

* Investigate discrepancies

* Verify findings before they are presented

* Identify missing or incomplete information

* Track unresolved items

* Conduct research

* Maintain organized client records

* Prepare reports and summaries

* Help determine which findings actually require attention



We want someone who sees something unusual and naturally wants to understand why.



### SaaS & Technology Operations



You may work with tools such as:



* Airtable

* Excel / Google Sheets

* ChatGPT and other AI tools

* CRM systems

* 
, n8n, or Zapier

* Databases and APIs

* Internal dashboards and automation systems



You do NOT need to already be an expert in every tool.



We care much more about intelligence, adaptability, judgment, and willingness to learn.



Experience with automation, data analysis, Python, SQL, APIs, or databases is valuable, but this is not a pure developer position.



### Client Success



As you learn the business, an important part of this role will be communicating directly with U.S. cemetery owners and managers.



Eventually, you may:



* Participate in Zoom and phone calls

, n8n, or Zapier

As part of our HR evaluation process, please review the attached case and send back your answers when ready  take the time you need. 



 CANDIDATE CASE EXERCISE Growing a Local Home-Services Business Marketing & SEO Role — Anchor Point Masonry Harrisburg, PA | South Central Pennsylvania Market COMPANY BACKGROUND The company is a home-services contractor based in the Harrisburg, PA area. Masonry work — including certified chimney repair — is the company's core specialty, with basement remodeling offered as a secondary service. The company positions itself as a regional specialist rather than a general contractor. COMPANY GOALS 

? Generate a consistent flow of organic leads, not just paid ones. 

? Improve the company website itself — design, usability, and overall quality.

 ? Build a stronger overall digital presence for the brand.

 ? Establish and grow a presence on relevant social media channels, which the company does not currently have.

 ? Be recognized in search and in the local market as the area's specialist in masonry and chimney work — not a generalist contractor.

 ? Spend marketing dollars efficiently, with every dollar traceable to a measurable outcome. 

CURRENT SITUATION The company currently uses Houzz Pro as its CRM, and its website exists as a page inside that platform. The domain itself is owned by the company, but lead generation through the site appears limited within this setup. The company has no established social media presence. It is looking for a proposal on how to generate more organic leads and build a stronger digital presence overall. 



YOUR TASK Assume you have just started in this role. Using the company background, goals, and current situation outlined above, answer each question as specifically as possible. Vague or generic answers will be weighted lower than concrete, defensible recommendations. 

1. The website currently sits inside Houzz Pro, and the domain is owned by the company. Explain, technically, why lead generation and SEO performance are constrained in this setup — name the specific technical or structural limitations, not just "it's not our site." What specifically would change once the site moves to independent hosting? 

2. Propose your organic lead generation plan. Name the specific channels you'd prioritize (and which you'd deliberately skip), and justify each choice against this company's market, trade, and customer type — not a general-purpose small-business answer. 

3. Outline the website improvements you'd make, in priority order. For each one, state the specific problem it solves, how you'd verify it worked, and what you'd expect to see change if it didn't. 

4. Give a concrete 30/60/90-day plan. Each phase should list specific deliverables and the metric that proves that phase succeeded — not just a list of activities.

 5. Define your reporting model: what exact numbers would you track weekly and monthly, where would each number come from, and what specific result would trigger you to change course?

 6. Propose a first-90-days budget broken into line items. For each line item, state the expected outcome you'd hold yourself accountable to, and how you'd know within 90 days if that line item wasn't working. 



This is a working assessment, not a writing exercise. We are evaluating the specificity and technical grounding of each answer, not the length or polish of the writing. Answers that restate the prompt, rely on generic marketing language, or could apply to any small business without modification will be scored lower than answers that clearly reflect hands-on experience with a business of this type

title: Operations Program Manager / Chief of Staff
description:
Engineering Studio 



What you own



You're handed a defined goal — already scoped, already d
. From there it's yours: build the plan, identify who needs to move, get them moving, track whether it's actually happening, escalate the 
nt it stalls. You're accountable for outcomes on programs that don't belong to any single team.



You also keep the operating rhythm of the studio intact. That means running the meeting cadence, following up on the commitments people actually made, and making sure decisions get implemented — not just discussed and quietly dropped. When a decision gets made, you make sure everyone affected understands what it means for them, specifically, and actually does it. Catching agreement that wasn't real internalization — before it turns into silent non-alignment — is core to this job, not a side task.



You'll have real, appropriate authority in your scope. Not proximity dressed up as influence, not soft power you have to negotiate for every time. Real authority, held accountable.



You are not shaping strategy — that stays upstream. You are the reason strategy turns into something real, and the reason nothing falls through the cracks between the decisions made and the people executing them.



What disqualifies you



Needing to be managed, reminded, or chased. We manage work, not people.

Explaining intent when corrected instead of fixing. If the correction was clear, "why" isn't needed — only the adjustment.

Agreeing in the room, then not actually internalizing or executing the decision.



What you need



A track record of owning outcomes across teams that don't report to you

Real systems thinking — you see how the pieces connect, not just the next checklist item

Comfortable being the one who says the uncomfortable, accurate thing when a decision isn't actually landing

The ability to take a live correction and produce a clean fix, fast, without it becoming a conversation about you

No specific degree or credential required.



How we hire for this



Not a narrative interview. We've found what people say about handling correction and what they actually do under real, live correction are two different tests — so we run the second one.



Application: a few standard questions about how you approach structure, correction, ambiguity. Not scored as truth. It's a baseline we compare against what we see live.



Live round: real (anonymized) program material, worked through in real time, with direct correction delivered at least twice in the same session. We're not scoring whether your first answer is right. We're watching the gap between the correction landing and the fix starting — and whether that gap shrinks the second time.



If you can take a clear correction and move without needing it softened, apply.

title: Executive & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Full-Time Remote — 40 Hours/Week

Long-Term Opportunity | New York City-Based Business

Compensation: $1,100–$1,400 USD/month depending on experience and ability



ABOUT THE ROLE



DM Plaza is looking for a highly organized, reliable, and proactive Executive & Operations Virtual Assistant to support ownership across multiple businesses operating from a commercial property in New York City.



Our businesses span food, retail, events, and healthcare.



Your job is to help keep the operation organized behind the scenes: projects moving, communication clear, information accurate, follow-ups completed, files organized, and important deadlines visible.



This is not a role where you wait for someone to assign you individual tasks throughout the day.



We are looking for someone who can receive a goal or request, organize the work around it, identify missing information, follow up with the appropriate people, and help move it toward completion.



You will work closely with ownership and gradually take responsibility for increasingly important operational processes.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Executive & Operational Support



- Maintain project trackers, task lists, deadlines, and follow-ups

- Turn meetings, messages, voice notes, and instructions into clear action items

- Coordinate schedules, meetings, reminders, and recurring responsibilities

- Draft professional
s, messages, and vendor communications

- Conduct research and present findings clearly\

- Follow up with vendors, contractors, managers, candidates, and other stakeholders

- Identify stalled work or approaching deadlines and flag them before they become problems

- Prepare concise status updates showing what is complete, outstanding, blocked, or requires a decision



COMMUNICATION AND ACCOUNTABILITY 



Consistent communication is a major part of this role.



You will be expected to:



- Communicate when assigned work is received

- Provide updates on longer-running work

- Clearly flag blockers or missing information

- Ask useful questions when necessary

- Confirm completion of important tasks

- Keep project systems updated rather than relying on memory

- Escalate problems early rather than waiting until a deadline is missed



We value reliability and visibility. Ownership should not have to chase you to understand the status of your work.



FILE, DATA & SYSTEMS ORGANIZATION



Organize Google Drive folders, documents, contracts, proposals, and digital assets



- Maintain spreadsheets and operational databases

- Keep records accurate and updated

- Create clear filing, naming, and documentation systems

- Maintain checklists and recurring processes

- Help document SOPs

- Work comfortably with structured text and Markdown



RECRUITING COORDINATION

- Post and maintain job openings

- Organize applications

- Maintain applicant tracking

- Coordinate interviews

- Communicate with candidates

- Track interview status, feedback, and follow-ups

- Keep hiring pipelines organized and current



CONTENT & CANVA SUPPORT



- Create and modify clean Canva graphics using existing brand direction

- Resize and adapt designs for different formats

- Organize photos, videos, and other media assets

- Upload and organize website and social content

- Make basic content updates when needed



You do not need to be a professional graphic designer, but you should be comfortable producing clean, professional work in Canva.



DIGITAL TOOLS & TESTING



- Use and test internal tools built with platforms such as Glide

- Test workflows, forms, pages, links, and user experiences

- Document bugs and problems clearly

- Perform basic website and backend administrative updates

- Work with tools such as Google Workspace, Vercel, Canva, and other business software

- Learn unfamiliar software quickly

- Programming or application development experience is not required.



AI TOOLS



- Comfort using modern AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar systems is strongly preferred.



However, we do not want someone who simply copies AI-generated answers. Good AI use means:



- Giving the tool sufficient context

- Writing thoughtful prompts

- Checking its work

- Correcting mistakes

- Applying your own judgment

- Verifying important information

- Editing the output so it actually solves the problem



AI should improve your work — not replace thinking.



NOTE: Candidates may be assessed on their ability to use AI appropriately during the interview process.



----

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



MUST HAVES:

- At least 1–2 years of experience supporting an executive, business owner, or senior leader in an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, or similar role

- Excellent organizational ability

- Strong written and spoken English

- Very strong attention to detail

- Consistent and proactive communication

- Reliable and responsive during agreed working hours

- Able to work independently

- Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously

- Strong follow-through

- Naturally comfortable using checklists, trackers, and systems

- Able to learn unfamiliar software quickly

- Good judgment about when to solve something independently and when to escalate

- Comfortable receiving instructions through messages, meetings, voice notes, and recorded videos

- Stable computer and internet connection



THE TYPE OF PERSON WHO WOULD DO WELL HERE:



You will likely enjoy this position if you naturally think:

- “I should put that into the tracker.”

- “I haven't heard back from them, so I'll follow up.”

- “This deadline is approaching, so I should flag it.”

- “There is information missing here. Let me figure out what we need.”

- “We do this repeatedly. We should make a checklist.”

- “Before I send this, let me verify that it's actually correct.”



You may not enjoy this position if you prefer receiving one isolated task at a time and waiting for additional instructions after completing it.



PREFFERED EXPERIENCE:



Experience with some of the following is useful:

- Operations coordination

- Project coordination

- Google Workspace

- Google Sheets

- Canva

- Glide as an end user or administrator

- Recruiting or applicant tracking

- Vendor coordination

- Website administration

- Social media or content organization

- AI productivity tools



You do not need experience with every tool.



Ability to learn, organize, communicate, and exercise good judgment matters more.



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position.



You must consistently overlap with New York business hours.



We expect approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with Eastern Time, with the remaining hours potentially completed asynchronously depending on responsibilities.



Consistent communication during your scheduled working hours is required.



AVAILABILITY AND TIME OFF



At the beginning of each month, you will maintain an updated availability calendar covering approximately the next 30 days.



This should include:



- Planned time off

- Philippine holidays that affect your availability

- Appointments or commitments that affect working hours

- Other known schedule changes



Unexpected emergencies happen, but planned absences should be communicated as early as reasonably possible.



PERFORMANCE & MEASUREMENT



We believe good operations should be measurable.



The goal is not to monitor every minute you work. The goal is to make responsibilities and outcomes clear.



Depending on the responsibility, we may track things such as:



- Tasks completed on time

- Overdue work

- Follow-up completion

- Response and communication reliability

- Accuracy

- Project progress

- Recruiting pipeline activity

- Content output

- Documentation quality

- Errors and corrections

- Process improvements



You should be comfortable working in an environment where responsibilities have clear expectations and results are reviewed.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



This is intended to be a long-term position.



As you demonstrate reliability and good judgment, you can take ownership of increasingly important operational responsibilities.



The role may evolve substantially as DM Plaza grows.



COMPENSATION



$1,000–$1,300 USD per month, depending on experience, demonstrated ability, and assessment performance.



Exceptional candidates may be considered above this range.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:

1. Your resume

2. Your expected monthly compensation in USD

3. Your available working hours stated in New York Eastern Time

4. A short description of the most complex business, executive, or operational project you have helped organize

5. An example of a system, checklist, or process you personally created or improved

6. A 60–90 second video introduction explaining why you would be good at this role



QUESTION 1



You are maintaining a project tracker and notice that an important vendor deliverable is due in three days.



The vendor has not responded to the previous message, and the person internally responsible for the project has not followed up.



What would you do?



Please keep your answer under 150 words.



QUESTION 2

Tell us about one way you currently use AI to help you work.



Explain:



- What you use it for

- What information you normally give it

- How you determine whether its answer is actually good

- One example of a mistake or weak answer you have received from AI and how you corrected it



Please answer this yourself. We are interested in your judgment and working process, not a polished AI-generated response.



To confirm that you read the complete posting, begin your application with:



DM PLAZA — ORGANIZED

s

 Messenger

Previous experience with lead generation, appointment setting, cold calling, cold
,
 outreach, CRM software, sales, web design agencies, SEO agencies, or digital marketing agencies is strongly preferred.

Before You Apply



I personally read every application.

Want to stand out?

After submitting your application here, feel free to
 me directly at

Gavin

title: Digital Marketing & Funnel Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing & Funnel Specialist



We are seeking a creative, tech-savvy, and highly resourceful **Digital Marketing & Funnel Specialist** to join our growing team.



This is a hands-on execution role for someone who is equally comfortable building a sales funnel inside GoHighLevel, designing a carousel in Canva, editing a short-form video, and using AI to work smarter and faster.



We are NOT looking for someone who only knows how to post on social media. We need someone who understands digital marketing, has a strong creative eye, can learn quickly, and can take an idea or direction and turn it into a polished finished product.



**IMPORTANT: To be considered, begin your application with the word “ELEVATE.” Applications that do not include this word at the very top will not be considered.**



Key Responsibilities:



Funnels & GoHighLevel



* Build and design landing pages, opt-in pages, sales pages, thank-you pages, and other funnels inside GoHighLevel

* Create visually appealing funnel graphics and page elements

* Build forms, surveys, and basic funnel components within GHL

* Update and maintain existing funnels as needed

* Ensure funnels are mobile-friendly, visually consistent, and functioning properly

* Follow provided brand guidelines and marketing direction when creating pages



Graphic Design & Social Media



* Design and edit Instagram carousels, promotional graphics, story graphics, covers, and other social media assets

* Turn ideas, raw content, and existing materials into visually engaging content

* Maintain consistent branding across all graphics and platforms

* Repurpose existing content into multiple pieces of social media content



Short-Form Video Editing



* Edit Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and other short-form videos

* Add captions, text overlays, transitions, B-roll, hooks, and other engaging elements where appropriate

* Turn raw video footage into polished, platform-ready content

* Repurpose longer videos or existing content into short-form clips



Content Publishing & Management



* Upload, schedule, and/or publish approved content across multiple social media platforms

* Format posts appropriately for each platform

* Keep content organized and ensure posts are published according to the content schedule

* Assist with repurposing content across Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, and other platforms as needed



AI & Digital Tools



* Be comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT to assist with content creation, research, ideation, repurposing, and workflow efficiency

* Stay up to date with new AI tools, social media features, and digital marketing trends

* Look for ways to use technology and automation to improve efficiency

* Be willing and able to quickly learn new software and systems



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Creative with a strong eye for clean, modern design

* Experienced with **GoHighLevel**

* Experienced with **Canva**

* Comfortable editing short-form video

* Familiar with social media platforms and content formatting

* Comfortable working with AI tools

* Tech-savvy and able to learn new systems quickly

* Organized and able to manage multiple projects

* Detail-oriented and able to follow instructions

* Resourceful and willing to problem-solve before immediately asking for help

* Able to meet deadlines and communicate proactively

* Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

* Able to work independently without constant supervision



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* GoHighLevel funnel/page builder

* Canva

* CapCut or similar video editing software

* ChatGPT and other AI tools

* Instagram

* TikTok

*

* YouTube

* Content scheduling tools

* Digital products, online education, coaching, service-based businesses, or personal brands



This Role Is NOT For You If...



* You only specialize in one area and are unwilling to learn the others

* You need detailed step-by-step instructions for every task

* You frequently miss deadlines without communicating

* You submit work without checking it for errors

* You are uncomfortable using AI or learning new technology

* You cannot take creative direction or make revisions

* You disappear when you encounter a problem instead of communicating



We value people who are **resourceful, accountable, creative, communicative, and solution-oriented.**



How to Apply



Remember: **Your application MUST begin with the word “ELEVATE.”



Then include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant experience

2. Your experience specifically with **GoHighLevel**

3. Links or examples of funnels/landing pages you have personally built

7. Your current availability and preferred working hours

8. Your desired hourly rate

Compensation & Schedule

Starting Rate: $5 USD/hour

Schedule: 4 hours per day, 5 days per week

Starting Hours: 20 hours per week

Trial Period: The position will begin with a 2-week paid trial period

Growth Opportunity: There is room for increased hours, responsibilities, and compensation based on performance, reliability, quality of work, and the needs of the company.



The 2-week trial period will allow us to evaluate your ability to follow direction, meet deadlines, communicate effectively, maintain brand consistency, and independently execute both creative and technical tasks.



Candidates who perform well during the trial period will have the opportunity to continue in the role long-term and grow with the company.



**Please do not apply without examples of your previous work.**

title: Video Editor
description:
We’re looking for a talented Video Editor to join Sunco’s Marketing team and support the growth of our video content pipeline. This role will focus on editing both short-form and long-form videos for ads, social media, tutorials, and brand storytelling. 







You’ll collaborate closely with content managers, writers, designers, and videographers to bring video concepts to life while maintaining Sunco’s brand standards and performance goals. 







What you'll do

- Optimize video files, thumbnails, titles, and metadata for SEO and discoverability. 

- Stay up to date on industry trends, creator best practices, and competitor content, and suggest new formats or creative tests. 

- Organize and maintain video assets, project files, and exports for efficient collaboration and reuse. 

Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and partner teams while maintaining quality and timelines.

Qualifications

- Experience editing content from a variety of sources, including product footage, lifestyle shoots, UGC, and screen recordings.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a distributed, multicultural team environment. 

- Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. 

- Passion for staying current with video trends, tools, and best practices. 

- Experience with product, ecommerce, or B2B video campaigns is a plus. 

- Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken). 

- Ability and willingness to work hours that substantially overlap with 9:00 am – 5:00 pm Pacific Time. 





Key Attributes:  



- High level of integrity and dedication to quality.  

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.  

- Strong commitment to process improvement and operational excellence 





Additional Requirements:  



- Availability to work between 8 AM to 5 PM Pacific Time   

- Reliable internet access and a private remote workstation. 





How to apply:



- Please send or attach your resume to the application   

- Kindly ensure that your resume is submitted in English, as applications with resumes in other languages will not be considered.   





About the Company   







Sunco Lighting is an online lighting retailer based in Valencia, CA. Thanks to our amazing and talented employees, today we are one of the largest online lighting retailers in the US. We value our collaborative, open, and people-first culture deeply, and we are invested in making Sunco a positive place where our tea
mbers thrive every day.

title: Amazon FBA UK Wholesale Sourcing VA
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon FBA UK Wholesale Sourcing VA to join our team and take full responsibility for finding and developing profitable wholesale opportunities within the UK market.



This is NOT an entry-level VA position. We are specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon FBA wholesale in the UK and knows how to identify genuine, profitable products and suppliers.



Your Role



Your main responsibility will be to find UK brands, wholesalers and authorised distributors that we can build long-term purchasing relationships with.



You will:



Research and identify UK brands, wholesalers and distributors

Contact suppliers using our dedicated company

Send professional wholesale enquiries and follow up consistently

Apply for trade/wholesale accounts where appropriate

Request wholesale catalogues, price lists, MOQ information and trading terms

Research supplier catalogues for products suitable for Amazon FBA UK

Analyse products for profitability, ROI, sales potential and competition

Use tools such as Keepa, SellerAmp SAS and Amazon Seller Central

Identify products with strong margins and consistent sales

Look for products that can be reordered consistently, rather than one-off opportunities

Maintain and organise a detailed supplier database

Track contacted suppliers, responses, accounts, catalogues and opportunities

Present profitable products to management for approval

Follow up with suppliers regularly and develop long-term relationships

What We Are Looking For



Essential:



Proven experience with Amazon FBA UK wholesale

Strong understanding of the UK Amazon marketplace

Experience using Keepa and SellerAmp SAS

Understanding of Amazon fees, ROI, margins, sales rank and competition

Experience sourcing from UK brands, wholesalers or distributors

Strong product research and analytical skills

Excellent written English

Able to communicate professionally with suppliers

Highly organised and able to work independently

We Are NOT Looking For

Beginners trying to learn Amazon wholesale

General VAs with no Amazon FBA experience

People whose only experience is basic online arbitrage

People who need extensive training on Keepa, SellerAmp or Amazon FBA

Applicants who cannot demonstrate previous UK wholesale sourcing experience

What Success Looks Like



We are looking for someone who can build a consistent pipeline of genuine UK wholesale suppliers and profitable, replenishable products.



The goal is not simply to find random products.



We want to build long-term supplier relationships and a repeatable wholesale operation where profitable products can be reordered month after month.



You will have access to a dedicated company
 for supplier outreach and will be expected to manage the day-to-day communication and sourcing process.



If you have genuine Amazon FBA UK wholesale experience and can demonstrate that you have successfully sourced profitable products and suppliers before, we want to hear from you.



Please include details of your previous Amazon FBA wholesale experience, tools you use, types of suppliers you have sourced from, and examples of your previous results when applying.

title: Senior Escalation Engineer (Tier 3) - MSP, US Client Hours, Work From Home, Long Term
description:
Crown Computers is a managed services provider in San Diego, California. We help businesses and their employees with IT issues and manage the networks, servers, and cloud environments for roughly 60 small and mid-sized businesses. I have run this business for 30 years, and I am the owner. We are a 13-person team, completely virtual, and we all genuinely like each other.



This is our senior engineer seat - the engineer the hard stuff goes to. It is the only role we are hiring right now, and we are hiring one person for the long term.



THE ROLE



You are the escalation point for our Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers. When a ticket has been touched twice or has run past four hours, it comes to you. You work it through to resolution, keep everyone informed along the way, and leave behind documentation the next engineer can act on.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Own escalations from our Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers through to resolution

- Troubleshoot across networking, Windows server, virtualization and Microsoft 365 environments

- Communicate clearly while you work - with our team, with vendors, and occasionally with clients

- Document as you go. Every escalation you close leaves behind clear notes the next engineer can use. Documentation matters a lot to us.

- Help us improve: spot recurring issues, suggest permanent fixes, make our processes a little better every month

- Speak up when you are blocked - we would always rather hear about it early



Anything physical - swapping hardware, running cable, being onsite - stays with our US engineers, so you can focus on the interesting work.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- 10+ years in IT support or systems engineering, with real Level 3 depth - you have been the escalation point before, ideally at a managed services provider

- Strong networking: firewalls, switching, VLANs, VPN, DNS, DHCP

- Strong Windows server: Active Directory, Group Policy, Hyper-V or VMware

- Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration

- Strong written English - your documentation will be read and relied on by US engineers

- Clear spoken English - you will be on calls with vendors and occasionally with clients

- Reliable power and internet, with a backup plan for both



WHAT WE USE



Kaseya VSA ( moving to Ninjarmm) , ConnectWise Manage, Hudu, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, Windows Server
, Active Directory, Hyper-V and VMware, Sophos, SonicWall and Ubiquiti, Acronis, Synology, DNS, DHCP, VPN, L2/L3 switching, Dell iDRAC, Exchange.



You do not need every one of these. Deep on several and comfortable learning the rest is exactly right.



THE SCHEDULE



Our clients work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, and this seat supports them live - so the hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific, which is 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM in Manila, five days a week. We know that schedule is not for everyone, and that is completely okay. Many experienced engineers have worked US hours for years and genuinely prefer it - if that is you, everything else about this job is built to make it worth your while.



There is a 15-minute stand-up on Microsoft Teams at the start of the shift, camera on. After that you get your day to work - we do not sit on video calls all day. Log your time daily.



TALK TO OUR PHILIPPINE TEA
MBER BEFORE YOU D



We already have an employee in the Philippines who has been with us 3 to 4 years - working these exact hours. Once we are far enough along, we will put you in touch with her privately so you can ask her anything about working for us, including what the schedule is honestly like. It is hard to judge a foreign employer from a job post - ask her instead of taking our word for it.



ABOUT US



Completely virtual, and we genuinely like each other:



- Good vibes

- Hard working

- Customer caring

- Friendly

- Open to suggestions, easy communication

- Most of us really love music and chat about fun things on our Microsoft Teams board

- Willing to share your technical opinion on how to fix something



PAY



$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month, based on experience and English. Paid monthly as an international contractor. We checked what other US MSPs are paying for this seat before we set this number, and it is deliberately above every one of them - because we are hiring for many years, not many weeks.



HOW TO APPLY - THIS IS PART OF THE TEST



1. Subject line, exactly this format:

L3 Engineer - [Your Name] - [the first thing you check on a server you have never seen before]



2. Attach your resume.



3. Attach a voice recording of yourself - WAV or MP3, two to three minutes - reading this question out loud and then answering it: "Tell me about the hardest technical problem you ever solved, and how you figured it out." No ZIP or RAR files. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed - we do this so we do not waste your time or ours on a call that was never going to work.



4. One line: can you work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time (11:00 PM - 8:00 AM Manila), five days a week, long term? An honest answer helps us both.



Short, specific and honest beats long and polished. If you have a story where you got it wrong for two hours before you got it right, that is the story we want.



OUR PROCESS



Stage 1 - these questions and your voice recording.

Stage 2 - a skills conversation on Microsoft Teams, 30 to 90 minutes, camera on.

Stage 3 - a PAID 90-minute practical exercise in a live Microsoft 365 environment. We pay you for your time.

Then references and a background check.



Thanks for reading all the way to the bottom : )

mber to help them improve every single day.
