title: Surface Pattern & Textile Designer – Original Fabric Collections
description:
# Surface Pattern & Textile Designer — Original Fabric Collections




 is looking for a highly creative **artist, illustrator, and surface pattern designer** located in the Philippines to work directly with our team developing original fabric designs and complete fabric collections.



**Starting Pay: $5.00 USD/hour**

**Schedule: Part-Time to Start**

**Location: Remote — Philippines**

**Opportunity: Long-term position with potential for additional hours and responsibilities**



Please read this entire job posting carefully before applying. This is a specialized creative position, and we are looking for a very specific type of person.



## ABOUT THREADWORKS




 is a growing U.S.-based online retailer specializing in sewing, quilting, fabric, notions, machines, accessories, and other products for the sewing and quilting community.



We are now working toward an exciting new part of the business:



**Developing our own original fabric designs and collections.**



We want to build fabric collections that are unique to ThreadWorks — designs that can eventually be professionally printed, manufactured, photographed, marketed, sold online, and used by real customers in quilts and sewing projects.



We are looking for someone who can become an important part of that creative process.



This position will begin part-time. We are interested in developing a long-term relationship with the right designer, and there may be opportunities for the role and number of hours to grow as our original fabric program expands.



---



# THIS IS NOT A BASIC GRAPHIC DESIGN JOB



Please understand this before applying.



We are NOT primarily looking for someone to create:



* Canva templates

* Social media posts

*
 advertisements

* Basic website banners

* Logos

* Marketing flyers



We are looking for an **actual artist and designer**.



Someone who can start with a blank canvas and CREATE.



You should be able to draw, illustrate, develop original motifs, create patterns, understand color, brainstorm concepts, and eventually turn those ideas into professional seamless repeating designs suitable for printing on fabric.



Being technically good with Adobe Illustrator is valuable, but technical software ability alone is not enough.



**Creativity is one of the most important requirements for this position.**



---



# HOW WE WILL WORK TOGETHER



This will be a collaborative creative position.



Sometimes ThreadWorks will provide you with a very specific concept.



Other times, we may give you only a general direction.



For example, we might simply tell you:



**"Let's create a Southwest-inspired fabric collection."**



We do NOT want a designer who then needs us to tell them exactly what to draw, exactly where to place everything, and exactly which colors to use.



We want you to start thinking.



You might begin exploring:



* Desert wildflowers

* Cacti

* Agave

* Arizona landscapes

* Mountains

* Desert sunsets

* Western elements

* Horseshoes

* Cowboy boots

* Desert animals

* Southwestern geometric motifs

* Pottery-inspired shapes

* Turquoise

* Terracotta

* Rust

* Sage

* Sand

* Cream

* Warm sunset colors

* Tonal coordinates

* Small geometric patterns



But those are only examples.



**We want YOU to bring ideas that we haven't thought of.**



Maybe you take the concept in a completely different direction.



Great.



That's exactly the kind of creative thinking we're looking for.



---



# YOU WILL BE EXPECTED TO BRING IDEAS TO THE TABLE



We do not want the creative relationship to be:



**We tell you exactly what to do ? You make it.**



We want:



**We have an idea ? You have ideas ? We brainstorm ? You sketch concepts ? We discuss them ? We select a direction ? You develop it ? We make revisions ? We develop coordinating prints ? We test colors ? We refine everything ? We build a complete collection.**



We want someone comfortable saying:



"I have another idea."



"What if we tried this?"



"I think this color palette might work better."



"What if we made this motif smaller?"



"I think this could become a great coordinating pattern."



"What if we developed a second colorway?"



"I don't think this design is strong enough yet. I have another direction I'd like to show you."



We WANT that.



We don't want someone who simply agrees with everything.



If you have a better creative idea, show us.



---



# YOU ARE NOT JUST DESIGNING ONE PIECE OF FABRIC



A major part of this position will eventually be understanding how to build **complete fabric collections**.



Imagine we create a collection inspired by the American Southwest.



We may eventually want that collection to contain:



**1. HERO PRINT**



The main statement fabric containing the most important illustrations and colors.



**2. SECONDARY PRINT**



A complementary design that supports the hero.



**3. SMALL-SCALE PRINT**



Something that works well when cut into small pieces for quilting.



**4. FLORAL OR MOTIF COORDINATE**



A pattern using individual elements from the main collection.



**5. GEOMETRIC COORDINATE**



A complementary geometric design.



**6. TONAL PRINT**



A subtle pattern that almost reads as a solid from a distance.



**7. BLENDER**



A versatile supporting fabric that customers can combine with stronger designs.



**8. STRIPE OR LINEAR DESIGN**



A pattern using the collection's colors and visual language.



And then some of those designs may have several colorways.



One concept could eventually become **10, 15, 20, or more individual fabrics.**



You need to eventually learn to think beyond:



**"Is this one pattern pretty?"**



Instead:



**"Does this belong in a collection, and what else needs to exist around it?"**



---



# YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Your work may include:



* Creating original illustrations

* Creating original fabric designs

* Developing seamless repeating patterns

* Creating pattern tiles

* Creating straight repeats

* Creating half-drop repeats when appropriate

* Developing hero prints

* Developing secondary prints

* Creating coordinating patterns

* Creating blenders

* Creating tonal designs

* Creating geometric designs

* Creating floral patterns

* Creating novelty prints

* Developing stripes

* Developing small-scale quilting prints

* Creating multiple colorways

* Creating professional color palettes

* Adjusting pattern scale

* Adjusting spacing and density

* Developing multiple concepts from a single idea

* Sketching concepts

* Brainstorming new collections

* Presenting your own ideas

* Researching design trends

* Researching quilting and fabric trends

* Researching color trends

* Developing seasonal concepts

* Making revisions based on feedback

* Preparing artwork for manufacturing

* Maintaining editable source files

* Exporting high-resolution artwork

* Maintaining organized collection folders

* Keeping versions and colorways organized

* Helping us develop an identifiable ThreadWorks design style



---



# WE CARE ABOUT COMMERCIAL DESIGN



Being artistic is extremely important, but we are ultimately creating products.



You need to learn to ask:



**Would someone actually buy this fabric?**



A beautiful illustration does not automatically make a great quilting fabric.



We need to consider:



* How the pattern repeats

* How it looks across a full yard

* How it looks when cut into small pieces

* Motif scale

* Negative space

* Color

* Pattern density

* How it coordinates with other prints

* Whether it works in a quilt

* Whether the collection feels cohesive

* Whether individual fabrics can sell independently

* Whether several fabrics encourage customers to purchase the collection together



You do NOT need to currently be an expert in quilting.



However, you must be willing and interested in learning about the customer we are designing for.



---



# TECHNICAL SKILLS



Experience with **Adobe Illustrator** is strongly preferred.



Experience with **Adobe Photoshop** and/or **Procreate** is also valuable.



You should ideally understand some or all of the following:



* Vector illustration

* Raster illustration

* Seamless repeats

* Pattern tiles

* Straight repeats

* Half-drop repeats

* Motif placement

* Pattern scale

* Negative space

* Color palettes

* Colorways

* Layer organization

* High-resolution artwork

* Production-ready artwork

* Vector vs. raster files

* Professional file exporting



If you are an exceptional artist but have limited textile experience, we may still consider you if you are willing and able to learn quickly.



---



# ARTISTIC ABILITY MATTERS MORE THAN A DEGREE



A college degree is NOT required.



We care about what you can actually create.



Potential backgrounds include:



* Surface pattern design

* Textile design

* Illustration

* Graphic design

* Fine art

* Fashion design

* Digital art

* Print design

* Product design



Self-taught artists are welcome to apply.



A strong portfolio will matter much more to us than a diploma.



---



# COLOR SKILLS



Color is extremely important in fabric.



We want someone with a strong eye for:



* Color harmony

* Contrast

* Value

* Saturation

* Warm vs. cool colors

* Neutrals

* Accent colors

* Seasonal palettes

* Commercial color combinations



We may take one pattern and create many colorways before d
 which ones should move forward.



You should enjoy experimenting.



---



# RESEARCH & INSPIRATION



Part of the position will involve creative research.



You may research:



* Current quilting fabric trends

* Upcoming seasonal trends

* Color trends

* Fashion

* Interior design

* Art

* Nature

* Architecture

* Vintage artwork

* Historical design

* Crafting trends

* Successful fabric collections



Research is for understanding the market and generating ideas.



**It is NOT permission to copy other designers.**



---



# ORIGINALITY & INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY



This requirement is extremely important.



All final artwork produced for ThreadWorks must be original and legally suitable for commercial use.



You may NOT:



* Copy existing fabric designs

* Trace another artist's illustrations

* Recreate a competitor's collection

* Download artwork from Google and use it

* Take artwork from Pinterest

* Use copyrighted characters without authorization

* Use trademarked logos without authorization

* Submit another artist's work as your own

* Use stock artwork and pretend you illustrated it

* Reuse another client's proprietary artwork



We want to create a genuine original design library for ThreadWorks.



---



# AI USAGE



If you use generative AI anywhere in your creative process, you MUST tell us.



AI may sometimes be useful for brainstorming and concept exploration, but we need to know exactly how artwork was created.



Do not submit AI-generated artwork and tell us that you personally illustrated it.



Production artwork must meet our requirements for:



* Originality

* Commercial usability

* Quality

* Editability

* Resolution

* Consistency



---



# SOURCE FILES & ORGANIZATION



Organization is extremely important.



We may eventually have hundreds or thousands of design files, versions, patterns, and colorways.



Your files must be professionally organized.



We expect:



* Logical file names

* Organized layers

* Editable source files

* Clearly separated colorways

* Version control

* Organized collection folders

* High-resolution exports

* Production files separated from concept files



We do NOT want files named:



**final-final-NEW-final2-USETHISONE.ai**



If you become part of our team, another person should be able to open your files and understand how they are organized.



Because communication and attention to detail are extremely important to this position, there is one small application instruction included here. **When submitting your application, include the exact words "ThreadWorks Fabric Designer" somewhere in the first paragraph of your application.** Do not put it in the subject line. This simply helps us identify applicants who carefully read the complete job description.



---



# ENGLISH & COMMUNICATION



Strong English communication is required.



You do NOT need to speak perfect American English.



However, you must be comfortable communicating directly with an English-speaking team.



You should be able to:



* Understand detailed written instructions

* Discuss creative ideas

* Explain your artistic decisions

* Ask questions

* Participate in brainstorming

* Understand feedback

* Explain problems

* Give progress updates

* Participate in occasional calls when needed



Both written and spoken English matter.



---



# YOU MUST BE COMFORTABLE WITH FEEDBACK



Creative work requires revisions.



Sometimes we may love the first design.



Sometimes we may ask for changes.



Sometimes we may explore a concept and d
 it isn't good enough.



Sometimes we may d
 to start over completely.



You need to be comfortable with constructive feedback.



We want someone who:



* Does not take revisions personally

* Listens carefully

* Asks questions

* Implements feedback accurately

* Can explain their own creative reasoning

* Suggests alternatives

* Improves over time

* Learns what ThreadWorks customers respond to



We do NOT want someone afraid to disagree creatively.



If you believe you have a better solution, explain it and show us.



---



# THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Our ideal candidate is:



* Highly creative

* Artistic

* Detail-oriented

* Dependable

* Honest

* Organized

* Curious

* Self-motivated

* Good at communicating

* Comfortable working independently

* Able to meet deadlines

* Open to constructive criticism

* Excited to learn

* Interested in long-term work

* Constantly noticing interesting colors, patterns, shapes, and ideas

* Capable of taking a broad concept and developing it further



We want someone who genuinely enjoys creating.



---



# PORTFOLIO REQUIRED



Do not apply without a portfolio.



We want to see your strongest work.



Please show examples of:



* Original illustrations

* Repeating patterns

* Surface pattern design

* Textile designs

* Fabric designs

* Florals

* Geometric designs

* Hand-drawn artwork

* Digital artwork

* Pattern collections

* Coordinating prints

* Different colorways



You do NOT need examples from every category.



We would rather see **10 excellent pieces than 100 average pieces.**



If you have created artwork that has actually been commercially printed, please show us.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



We want detailed applications.



Please do NOT send:



**"Hi, I am interested in this position. Please see my portfolio."**



That will not be enough.



Your application should tell us about YOU.



Please answer the following:



**1. What is your full name and where in the Philippines are you located?**



**2. Tell us about your background as an artist/designer.**



**3. How many years have you been designing?**



**4. Have you created seamless repeating patterns before? Explain your experience.**



**5. Have you ever designed fabric, wallpaper, stationery, wrapping paper, apparel, or another commercially printed product?**



**6. Which software do you use?**



Please specifically tell us your experience level with:



* Adobe Illustrator

* Adobe Photoshop

* Procreate

* Any other design software



**7. How much of the artwork in your portfolio was personally illustrated by you?**



**8. Do you use generative AI in your design workflow? If yes, explain exactly how.**



**9. Provide a direct link to your portfolio.**



**10. Choose THREE pieces from your portfolio that best represent your abilities and explain why you selected each one.**



**11. What is your written English level?**



**12. What is your spoken English level?**



**13. Are you comfortable occasionally discussing designs through a voice/video call?**



**14. How many hours per week are you currently available?**



**15. What hours do you normally work in Philippine Time?**



**16. Are you currently working for other clients or employers?**



**17. Are you interested in a long-term position if this role grows?**



**18. What type of artwork do you most enjoy creating?**



**19. What type of artwork do you believe you are best at creating?**



**20. Have you ever worked with a client who gave you a broad idea rather than exact instructions? Tell us about that experience.**



---



# CREATIVE THINKING QUESTION



Do NOT create artwork for this question.



We simply want to understand how you think.



Imagine ThreadWorks tells you:



## "We want to develop an original fabric collection inspired by the American Southwest."



Give us **THREE completely different creative directions** you might explore.



For each direction, briefly describe:



* The overall concept

* Potential motifs

* The color palette

* The artistic style

* What the hero print could look like

* Two or three coordinating prints you might develop around it



There is no single correct answer.



We are looking for originality and creativity.



---



# DESIGN TEST FOR FINALISTS



After reviewing applications and portfolios, selected candidates may be invited to complete a small design test.



The test may involve taking a creative direction and developing an original fabric concept.



For example, we could ask you to develop:



* One original hero pattern

* One coordinating pattern

* One color palette

* A short explanation of your design choices



The test allows us to evaluate:



* Artistic ability

* Originality

* Pattern construction

* Color

* Commercial potential

* Creativity

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow a brief

* Communication

* Ability to make revisions



**Any test requirements, time expectations, compensation, and rights to the resulting artwork will be explained to finalists before the test begins.**



---



# COMPENSATION & HOURS



**Starting compensation is $5.00 USD per hour.**



This position will begin **part-time**.



We want to start by learning how well we work together before increasing the size of the role.



We care much more about finding the right designer than immediately filling a large number of hours.



If you consistently:



* Produce excellent work

* Bring strong ideas

* Communicate well

* Stay organized

* Meet deadlines

* Take feedback well

* Understand our customers

* Become more independent

* Help us create commercially strong designs



there may be opportunities for additional hours and greater creative responsibility as the ThreadWorks fabric program expands.



---



# WHAT WE HOPE THIS BECOMES



We are not looking for someone to make a few patterns and disappear.



We would like to develop a long-term creative relationship with the right person.



At first, we may work closely together on individual concepts.



Over time, we want our designer to understand ThreadWorks, our customers, our preferences, and the quilting market well enough to become increasingly independent.



Eventually, we would love to be able to say:



**"Let's start working on a new fall collection."**



And have you come back with:



* Original concepts

* Mood directions

* Color palettes

* Motif ideas

* Hero-print ideas

* Coordinate ideas

* Multiple potential directions



Then we work together to choose the strongest concept and turn it into a real collection.



The end goal is not artwork that sits in a folder.



The goal is to create designs that eventually become **real bolts of fabric**.



Fabric that is manufactured.



Fabric that is photographed.



Fabric that is sold.



Fabric that customers cut and sew.



Fabric that becomes quilts, bags, clothing, gifts, and other projects.



And hopefully, over time, fabric collections that customers recognize as coming from **ThreadWorks**.



If the idea of eventually seeing something you designed become a real physical fabric excites you, we want to see your work.



Please make sure you have carefully followed **all application instructions contained throughout this posting** before submitting your application.

title: Millwork Drafter (AutoCAD)
description:
Millwork company is seeking an experienced Millwork Drafter to produce precise, fabrication-ready shop drawings for high-end custom architectural millwork projects.

This is a production drafting position. The role focuses exclusively on AutoCAD shop drawings used directly for manufacturing and installation - not design development, 3D visualization, or rendering.

We are looking for a drafter who understands millwork construction, ideally with experience gained through prior drafting work in a millwork shop or hands-on experience in cabinet fabrication and installation. The ideal candidate understands how approved shop drawings translate into cutting, machining, assembly, and field installation.



Responsibilities

- Produce detailed, production-ready millwork shop drawings in AutoCAD based on architectural drawings and project scope

- Develop complete drawing sets including plans, elevations, sections, and fabrication details

- Fully dimension all components, materials, finishes, hardware, joinery, and clearances

title: Junior Fractional Controller / Finance & Revenue Operations Support with Quickbooks Experience
description:
Set2Close (Rowse Enterprises Inc.) — Remote, Philippines-based contractor Compensation: USD $6.00–$10.00/hour (based on experience) | Part-time / fractional, hours to be scoped Reports to: Chief Operating Officer





About the Role

Set2Close is a HubSpot Elite Partner RevOps consultancy. We're building out a junior fractional controller function to support client invoicing, payment reconciliation, and sales revenue tracking across our finance and revenue tech stack. This is not a senior controller role — it's a detail-oriented, process-driven support position for someone who wants to grow into finance operations, with real ownership from day one and direct mentorship from the COO.



You'll be one of the first dedicated hires in this function, helping formalize how we track money moving through the business — from signed contract, to invoice, to payment received, to sales reporting.





What You'll Do

Invoicing & AR follow-up: Create and track client invoices in QuickBooks Online (QBO); monitor accounts receivable aging and proactively follow up on overdue payments — flagging risk before it becomes a collections problem, not after.

Payment reconciliation: Match incoming payments across Loop Financial, Stripe, and 
 against invoices issued in QBO, and flag discrepancies.

Contract-to-invoice translation: Read signed client agreements (Statements of Work) and correctly build the invoice schedule from the payment terms described — due dates, milestone triggers, split payments — escalating anything ambiguous rather than guessing.

Sales attribution support: Work inside HubSpot to associate payments and invoices with the correct client deal record, supporting accurate monthly sales reporting.

Reporting support: Maintain and update recurring reports in Google Sheets (aging summaries, cash position, monthly sales rollups) with a high degree of accuracy.

Process adherence: Follow written finance SOPs precisely, and flag exceptions or process gaps rather than improvising a solution.





Required Skills & Experience

QuickBooks Online (QBO): hands-on invoicing and reconciliation experience — not just familiarity, actual working proficiency.

Advanced Google Sheets: comfortable with pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and multi-tab formula linking. This is used daily.

Accounts receivable / collections experience: demonstrated ability to independently identify overdue accounts and follow up professionally, without being prompted each time.

Payment platform experience: 
 and/or Stripe (credit card processing); Loop Financial or a similar cross-border payment platform is a strong plus.

Basic multi-currency comfort: able to work with USD-priced contracts against CAD-denominated books without confusion.

Contract comprehension: able to read a payment schedule in a signed agreement (e.g., "50% on signing, 25% at kickoff, 25% at milestone completion") and translate it accurately into an invoicing calendar.

P&L exposure: some prior exposure to profit & loss statements or basic financial reporting.

Strong written English: clear, professional communication — especially for client-facing payment follow-up
s.

High initiative / self-starter: comfortable operating with a written process and flagging exceptions, rather than needing step-by-step direction.





Nice to Have

Experience with HubSpot (CRM record navigation — you don't need sales experience, just comfort finding and updating deal records).

Experience with Teamwork (project/task management platform).

Prior experience working with a Canadian or US-based company, or in a RevOps/agency environment.

Experience working from documented SOPs in a finance or operations role.





Work Arrangement

Part-time / fractional, contractor basis.

Some real-time overlap with North American (Pacific Time) business hours is preferred — ideally at least 2–3 hours of overlap for daily coordination.

Fully remote.





Compensation

USD $6.00–$10.00/hour, commensurate with demonstrated experience and skill level. This is a junior-level role with room to grow in scope and compensation as the function matures.





How to Apply

A short note on your direct experience with QuickBooks Online invoicing and reconciliation.

Your available hours and time zone overlap with Pacific Time (PT).

title: AI Content Managers/Content Strategists
description:
We are seeking an AI Content Manager & Content Strategist who combines exceptional organization, strong long-form writing, strategic thinking, and hands-on execution.



This role is ideal for someone who loves taking large amounts of information—customer research, competitor research, ideas, data, transcripts, briefs, and existing content—and turning it into organized strategies and high-quality content that drives action and revenue.



You will own projects from the initial research and organization stage through messaging, content creation, landing-page execution, and performance analysis.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply asks ChatGPT to write articles.



We want someone who can think, research, organize, write, execute, analyze, and improve.



You should be equally comfortable working with long-form copy, data, AI tools, spreadsheets, and landing-page builders.



Start your application with “Kumusta” so we know you read the entire job description.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Content Strategy, Research & Organization



Research and organization are a major part of this position.



You will:



Conduct structured market and customer research

Identify customer pains, desires, motivations, objections, and demand signals

Research competitors, offers, positioning, messaging, and content

Analyze reviews, forums, comments, transcripts, websites, and other customer data

Organize large amounts of research into clear themes and insights

Build detailed content briefs and outlines

Maintain organized research libraries and documentation

Create and maintain content calendars and production workflows

Track projects, deadlines, drafts, revisions, and final deliverables

Build SOPs and repeatable processes when necessary



You should be the type of person who sees a messy collection of information and immediately thinks:



“How can I organize this?”



Exceptional organization is one of the most important requirements for this position.



2. Customer Awareness & Messaging Strategy



You will help determine what we should say, who we should say it to, and how the message should change depending on the customer.



You will:



Map customer segments by awareness level, from unaware through most aware

Identify the primary problems and desires of each audience

Determine which messages and angles are appropriate for different awareness levels

Develop messaging frameworks based on customer research

Identify objections that must be addressed before conversion

Translate research into actionable messaging and content strategies

Collaborate with stakeholders to maintain strategic alignment



You should understand that someone who is unaware of their problem requires a very different message from someone actively comparing solutions.



3. Long-Form Writing & Content



You must be an excellent long-form writer and editor.



You will write, edit, organize, or oversee:



Long-form articles

Educational guides

Landing pages

Sales pages

Advertorial-style content

Lead magnets

Case studies

 content

Headlines

Calls to action

Supporting sales and marketing content



You should be able to take extensive research and transform it into a clear, logical, engaging narrative.



Your writing should be:



Well researched

Structured

Easy to understand

Persuasive

Concise when necessary

Detailed when necessary

Written for humans, not algorithms



Strong editorial judgment is essential.



4. Offer & Messaging Development



This role goes beyond simply producing content.



You will also help develop and improve the offers behind the content.



You will help design and refine:



Core value propositions

Customer promises

Positioning

Differentiation

Unique mechanisms

Bonuses and incentives

Guarantees

Urgency frameworks

Calls to action

Offer structure



You will use customer research to determine why someone should choose our offer instead of competing alternatives.



You will also help ensure that the offer, message, and content are aligned with the customer's level of awareness.



5. AI-Assisted Research & Content



You should be highly comfortable using tools such as:



ChatGPT

Claude

Gemini

Other AI research and content tools



You will use AI for:



Research

Research synthesis

Competitor analysis

Customer analysis

Brainstorming

Developing angles

Creating outlines

Drafting

Editing

Content repurposing

Data analysis



However:



AI assists your thinking. It does not replace your thinking.



We do not want someone who copies and pastes AI-generated content.



You should be able to recognize weak AI output, restructure it, fact-check it, remove repetition, improve arguments, and turn it into polished work.



6. Landing Pages & Funnels



You will help turn strategies and content into actual pages and funnels.



Depending on the project, you may:



Build landing pages

Update existing pages

Structure long-form sales pages

Improve page flow

Implement headlines and calls to action

Optimize page sections for conversion

Work with designers or developers when necessary



Experience with one or more of the following is valuable:



Webflow

Framer

ClickFunnels

Shopify

Similar landing-page builders



You do NOT need to be a professional designer.



We care more about your ability to understand page structure, messaging hierarchy, user flow, and conversion.



7. Data Analysis & Optimization



Good content and marketing should produce measurable results.



You will use Excel or Google Sheets to:



Track content and campaign performance

Track conversion metrics

Document experiments

Compare results

Identify trends

Organize testing ideas

Determine opportunities for improvement



You will analyze conversion data and use those insights to improve:



Content

Messaging

Landing pages

Offers

Calls to action



We want someone who can look at performance data and ask:



“What is this telling us, and what should we change next?”



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



You should have:



Excellent written English

Excellent long-form writing ability

Exceptional organizational skills

Strong research skills

Strong editing and proofreading ability

Experience managing multiple content projects

Experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools professionally

Understanding of marketing and conversion principles

Understanding of direct-response marketing

Understanding of customer awareness levels and how they affect messaging

Ability to create detailed briefs and outlines

Ability to translate research into actionable decisions

Ability to work independently

High attention to detail

Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets



Experience with landing-page builders such as Webflow, Framer, ClickFunnels, or Shopify is strongly preferred.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



The right person is probably someone who is both creative AND extremely organized.



You enjoy writing, but you're not just a writer.



You enjoy research.



You enjoy understanding customers.



You enjoy organizing information.



You enjoy figuring out why something works.



You can receive:



50 pages of research

Competitor websites

Customer reviews

Interview transcripts

Existing content

Analytics

A rough business objective



…and turn everything into:



Organized Research ? Insights ? Strategy ? Offer ? Messaging ? Outline ? Content ? Landing Page ? Testing ? Improvement

title: Graphic Designer (Text-Based Sticker Design & Print Prep) — Long-Term Role, Sticker Printing & Graffiti Art Supply Brand
description:
About Us

Machine is a sticker printing and graffiti art supply company based in Las Vegas, Nevada. We run our own in-house sticker production — laminated, vinyl, holographic, kiss-cut, and individually cut stickers, printed, laminated, cut, packaged, and shipped entirely in-house — alongside our graffiti supply retail business and proprietary product line. The owner has over 20 years of professional graphic design experience, so you'll be working under someone who actually knows the craft, not just running production for a business owner outsourcing blind.



The Role

This is a long-term, full-time position — we're looking for someone who wants to build with the team over time, not a one-off project. You'll be designing text-based sticker artwork and preparing the final print and cut files that go straight into production.



What You'll Do

• Design text-based sticker artwork with strong typography — precise letter spacing, line spacing, and composition

• Prepare final print and cut files in Adobe Illustrator, including cut data for sticker sheets

• Catch and fix small errors before they hit production — a missed detail in a cut file causes a real production • problem, not just a redo

• Work closely with the production and support team to keep custom sticker orders on track and true to customer specs

• Take feedback and direction well, and iterate quickly when something needs adjusting



What We're Looking For

• A strong eye for typography — you understand how letter spacing, line spacing, and composition make or break a design

• Extremely detail-oriented. The design work itself isn't hard, but this role has zero tolerance for carelessness — small mistakes in cut files are easy to make and costly to miss

• Proficient in Adobe Illustrator (required). We'll train you on our specific cut-file process — you don't need prior sticker/print experience, just strong Illustrator fundamentals

• A portfolio that shows clean, precise execution — we're looking for care and consistency as much as creativity

• Looking for a long-term role, not project-based or freelance work



Compensation

$7/hour to start, increasing to $8/hour after 90 days of solid performance, with yearly reviews and raises after that.



Hours

Full-time. 40 hrs/week with overlap during Pacific time business hours 11am to 7pm.



Hiring Process

Short application (10–15 minutes), a quick screening call, and a short PAID trial task before a final decision — so you'll get to show us your eye for detail directly, not just describe it.



To Apply





— please include a link to your portfolio when you apply.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:

 Maven

I am a solopreneur running a growing boutique agency. My 3 person team is dedicated entirely to client work, which means I need a highly capable virtual assistant to support me directly across sales, marketing, and operations.

Your primary focus is sales support. I attend conferences, speak at events, and generate leads — and I need someone to help me follow up fast, keep prospects warm, and move deals forward in HubSpot while I focus on relationships and strategy. Marketing is the second priority: it feeds the pipeline, so consistency matters.

You should be comfortable working independently, communicating clearly in English, and using AI tools — including Claude and ChatGPT — to produce high-quality work efficiently. You do not need to create strategy; you need to execute it excellently.



What You Will Do

1. Sales & HubSpot CRM (Primary Focus)

This is the most important part of the role. I need someone who will keep the sales engine running when I am busy serving clients, speaking at events, or traveling.

- Keep HubSpot CRM up to date at all times — contacts, deal stages, notes, and follow-up tasks after every call or conference

-When I return from a conference, help me execute the follow-up process quickly — entering contacts, sending outreach
s, and moving leads into the pipeline

s, schedule calls, and keep deals moving so nothing falls through the cracks

-Build and manage lead nurture
 campaigns in HubSpot to keep prospects warm between touchpoints

2. Content & Social Media Marketing

Marketing feeds the sales pipeline. Your job is to keep
 Maven showing up consistently so that prospects already know who I am before I reach out.

-Take long-form blog posts and prepare them for publishing on my Wix website — formatting, images, SEO basics, and going live

-Create a branded graphic to accompany each blog post using Canva

-Use my existing PowerPoints, documents, and presentations to write high-quality long-form blog content (bonus skill — helpful but not required from day one)



3. Monthly Newsletter

-Ensure both versions are consistent, on-brand, and go out on schedule

-Build and maintain simple AI agents or automated workflows to support agency operations

-Proactively suggest ways AI tools can improve our processes and save time



6. Inbox Support (Long-Term)

As trust is established, you will take on inbox management — flagging priority messages, drafting responses for my review, and eventually handling routine communications independently.

Required

• Strong written English — you will be writing sales outreach and content that represents my brand publicly

• Experience with HubSpot CRM and/or Marketing Hub — keeping pipelines clean and campaigns running

• Comfortable doing prospect research and writing professional outreach
s

 marketing or social media scheduling platform

title: Creator Growth Manager (Influencer + Affiliate + UGC) for US Supplement Brand
description:
BUILD OUR CREATOR ARMY — Part-Time to Full-Time, Long-Term



WHO WE ARE

CODE Nutra is a fast-growing US supplement brand. We sell through our Shopify store and Meta ads, and we're now building our next major acquisition channel: creators — Instagram, TikTok, and our affiliate program (UpPromote).



We're not looking for an "affiliate admin." Our software already handles links, tracking, and payouts. We're hiring someone to BUILD AND OWN our entire creator growth engine — and we'll give you real ownership as you prove yourself.



THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE

Recruit creators who fit our brand, get them making content that actually converts, and grow your creator portfolio into one of our biggest revenue channels.



Think of it like running an investment portfolio: recruit creators, invest time in them, double down on winners, cut non-performers, repeat.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



1. Creator acquisition — Find and recruit creators who genuinely fit CODE across TikTok and Instagram (including Instagram Creator Marketplace and TikTok's creator tools). Quality over follower count. Build toward an active network of 250+ creators.



2. Relationship management — Be the single point of contact for every creator. Keep them engaged month after month, reactivate inactive ones, and build long-term relationships instead of one-off posts.



3. Affiliate growth — Get creators into our affiliate program, help them succeed, track performance, scale the winners, remove the non-performers.



4. UGC pipeline — Brief creators so they make content that converts, not just content that looks nice. Review submissions and reject what won't perform. Secure usage rights and whitelisting. Keep our ad team supplied with fresh creative.



5. Paid ads feedback loop — Work with our ad team to learn which creators and videos are actually converting as paid ads. Double down on those creators and feed the insights back into your recruiting.



HOW THE ROLE STARTS

60-day paid trial at 25 hrs/week. You'll run the full pipeline — sourcing, pitching, briefing, managing — but every deal (rates and terms) gets a quick approval from us before it's confirmed. Hit your trial targets and you convert to full-time (40 hrs/week). Once you've closed 20-30 deals and shown good judgment, you get your own budget and rate card and run deals end-to-end. This role is designed to grow — in hours, ownership, and pay.



Note: after conversion to full-time, we expect this to be your only client. During the trial, that's up to you.



HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED (OUTCOMES, NOT ACTIVITY)

We will never measure you on messages sent or meetings booked. We measure:

- Active creators and active affiliates in your portfolio

- Monthly revenue generated by your creator portfolio

- Number of usable UGC assets delivered to our ad team

- % of creators still active after 90 days

- Number of creators whose content runs as paid ads



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience managing influencers, affiliates, or UGC creators for a DTC/e-commerce brand (show us, don't just tell us)

- Excellent written English — your outreach messages ARE the job

- You can tell the difference between content that converts and content that just looks good, and you can explain why

- Experience with Instagram and TikTok as marketing channels; familiarity with affiliate software (UpPromote, GoAffPro, Refersion, or similar) is a plus

- Organized: you can track hundreds of relationships without dropping any

- Self-directed: you bring us plans, not questions

- At least 4 hours of overlap with US Pacific time



COMPENSATION

- $6-$7/hour depending on experience, paid twice monthly

- Trial: 25 hrs/week (~$650-$760/month). Full-time after conversion: 40 hrs/week (~$1,040-$1,215/month)

- 13th month pay after conversion to full-time

- Paid PH holidays after probation

- Raises tied to portfolio milestones, reviewed every 6 months



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY

We only review applications that follow these instructions exactly. Start your application with the word PORTFOLIO on the first line.



Then answer these four things (keep the whole application under 500 words):



1. EXPERIENCE: Describe ONE creator or affiliate campaign you personally managed. What was the brand, what did you do, and what were the results (numbers, please)?



2. CONTENT TASTE: Find one supplement/health brand video ad on TikTok or Instagram that you think converts well. Link it, and in 3-4 sentences tell us WHY it converts.



3. OUTREACH TEST: Write the exact first message you would send to a 30k-follower fitness creator to get her interested in partnering with CODE. Write it as if you're sending it right now.



4. LOGISTICS: Your expected hourly rate, your available hours (in US Pacific time), and your internet speed test result (speedtest.net screenshot link).



Applications that are clearly AI-generated, copy-pasted, or skip any of the four items will not receive a reply. The ones that show real taste and real writing will hear from us within 3 business days.

description:
Why This Role Is Worth Your Attention



LookUp Media LLC is a fast-growing digital media company producing content across YouTube, Patreon, and multiple online platforms — and we're going all-in on AI. We're looking for a sharp, curious Prompt Engineer who can turn AI tools into serious productivity multipliers for our creative and operational teams.



This isn't a "ChatGPT power user" role. We need someone who thinks in systems — someone who can engineer prompts that are replicable, scalable, and actually solve problems. If you love the craft of getting AI to do exactly what you need, we want to work with you.



About LookUp Media LLC



LookUp Media LLC is a digital media company specializing in video content creation, scriptwriting, and audience growth across platforms including YouTube, Patreon, and social media. We operate fully remotely with a tight-knit, driven team of over 90+ creative and operational professionals. We move fast, value initiative, and believe great systems free great people to do their best work.



What You'll Do

Design, test, and refine prompts for large language models (LLMs) including Claude, GPT-4o, and Gemini to support content creation, research, summarization, and operations workflows

Build and maintain a centralized Prompt Library — documenting, versioning, and categorizing prompts for team-wide use

Collaborate with scriptwriters, video editors, and team leads to identify AI automation opportunities and implement prompt-driven workflows

Evaluate AI output quality — assess accuracy, tone, creativity, and alignment with brand voice; iterate based on results

Create prompt templates and SOPs that non-technical tea
mbers can use confidently without engineering knowledge

Test AI tools and integrations (e.g., Claude API, OpenAI API, Make/Zapier AI modules) and recommend best-fit tools for specific use cases

Stay current on LLM research and best practices — bring emerging prompting techniques (chain-of-thought, few-shot, RAG, etc.) into practical use

Support AI-assisted content quality review — build evaluation rubrics and scoring systems for automated output checks

Assist in onboarding tea
mbers on AI tools and prompt usage best practices



What We're Looking For



Required:



Demonstrated experience engineering prompts for LLMs (Claude, GPT-4, Gemini, or equivalent)

Strong written English — you will write prompts in English and review English-language AI output

Ability to think systematically: breaking complex tasks into clear, step-by-step AI instructions

Experience with at least one automation or AI integration tool (Make, Zapier, n8n, LangChain, or similar)

Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment with minimal supervision

Strong documentation habits — you keep records, write clear SOPs, and maintain organized files



Nice to Have:



Experience in digital media, content production, or YouTube/Patreon ecosystem

Familiarity with the Anthropic Claude API or OpenAI API (REST API calls, JSON structure)

Basic Python or JavaScript knowledge for scripting prompt workflows

Background in copywriting, scriptwriting, or content strategy

Exposure to RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) or vector database concepts



You'll Thrive Here If You



Get genuinely excited when a prompt finally does exactly what you wanted

Can explain what you built to a non-technical creative tea
mber without jargon

Are self-directed — you don't wait to be told what to optimize next

Take ownership: if something's broken or inefficient, you fix it and document the fix

Are comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration



Schedule & Setup



100% Remote — work from anywhere in the Philippines

Flexible hours with a required overlap window (specific hours to be discussed during onboarding)

Output-based performance — we care about results, not clock-watching

Project-based deliverables with clear KPIs reviewed monthly



Rate reviewed after 90-day performance evaluation



How to Apply



Ready to join a team that's serious about AI?

**Full-Time | $5–$7/Hour + $500 Closing Bonus**



We are a real estate investment company looking to hire **two motivated and dependable Virtual Assistants** to join our team as Real Estate Cold Callers.



This is a full-time, long-term position for someone who is comfortable making outbound calls, speaking with homeowners, qualifying potential sellers, and keeping accurate notes and lead information.



## Compensation



* **Starting pay: $5 USD/hour**

* Opportunity to increase pay **up to $7 USD/hour** based on experience and performance

* **$500 BONUS** for every property generated from your leads that goes under contract **and successfully closes**

* 8 hours per day

* Long-term opportunity for strong performers



## Work Schedule



**Monday–Friday**

**11:30 AM – 7:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)**



You must be consistently available and ready to make calls during these hours.



## What You'll Be Doing



We will provide you with homeowner lists and the tools needed to make calls.



Your primary responsibility will be contacting homeowners to determine whether they may be interested in selling their property.



Daily responsibilities include:



* Cold calling homeowners from lists provided by our company

* Speaking professionally and confidently with property owners

* Determining whether the homeowner has an interest in selling

* Asking qualifying questions about the property and seller's situation

* Identifying motivation, property condition, asking price, and timeline

* Updating the lead list after each conversation

* Writing clear and detailed notes

* Recording call dispositions and follow-up information

* Identifying qualified and motivated seller opportunities

* Passing qualified leads to our acquisitions team

* Following our scripts, processes, and qualification guidelines

* Completing appropriate follow-up when required



## Tools & Experience



**You DO NOT need to provide your own dialer.** We will provide the calling system and necessary lead lists.



Previous experience with the following is a **PLUS:**



* **DataSift**

* **Smartphone Dialer**

* Real estate cold calling

* Real estate wholesaling

* Motivated seller lead generation

* Appointment setting

* Outbound sales



Candidates with relevant experience and strong performance may qualify for **higher hourly compensation, up to $7/hour.**



## Requirements



Our ideal candidate:



* Speaks clear, understandable English

* Is confident and comfortable speaking with U.S. homeowners

* Has reliable high-speed internet

* Has a reliable computer and quality headset

* Has a quiet working environment

* Can work the full **11:30 AM–7:30 PM ET** schedule

* Is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

* Can handle rejection and remain positive and persistent

* Is organized and takes detailed notes

* Can follow a script without sounding robotic

* Is dependable, punctual, and consistent

* Can work independently and stay productive

* Is motivated by performance and earning bonuses

In addition to your hourly pay, you will receive a:



**$500 BONUS for each property generated from your leads that goes under contract and successfully closes.**



There is no set limit on the number of closing bonuses you can earn.



If you consistently produce quality leads and perform well, there is also an opportunity to increase your hourly rate from **$5/hour up to $7/hour.**

1. A brief description of your previous cold-calling or sales experience

3. Whether you have experience using **DataSift**

We are hiring **two Virtual Assistants** and are looking for people who want to become long-ter
mbers of our team. Strong performance will be rewarded through **closing bonuses and opportunities for increased hourly pay.**

mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Quality-check every output against the actual product reference photos before anything goes out the door, comparing print patterns, color, scale, flange widths, fabric texture, stitching, and proportions to the real product side by side, and regenerating or retouching until the match is exact



- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief

The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"

title: SENIOR FULL STACK DEVELOPER | Remote | Full-Time
description:
WHY YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE



Most developer jobs have you maintaining other people's decisions.

This one is different.



At LookUp Media LLC, we're building a custom AI-powered video production

stack — internal tools that automate script-to-video generation, voice

synthesis, rendering pipelines, and content publishing for our digital

media channels. The models exist. The APIs are out there. Your job is to

build the systems that orchestrate all of it into something that actually

ships video, at scale, reliably.



If you've been waiting for a role where you build real AI-powered tools —

not just call ChatGPT in a web form — this is it.



?????????????????????????????????????



WHY WORK WITH US



? You will build the AI video stack from the ground up — real ownership

? Salary significantly above market rate, reflecting the specialization

? 100% remote, flexible schedule, deliverable-based accountability

? First-mover advantage: few teams in PH are doing this at this level

? Work directly with leadership — no layers of middle management

? Flat hierarchy — your technical decisions are the decisions

? Exposure to the cutting edge of AI video, voice, and media automation

? Opportunity to grow into a tech lead as the AI team scales



?????????????????????????????????????



WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND DO



AI Video Pipeline

- Design and build the end-to-end AI video generation pipeline:

  script input ? AI voiceover ? AI visuals ? video assembly ? export

- Integrate AI APIs for each pipeline stage: text generation (OpenAI /

  Claude), text-to-speech (ElevenLabs / Murf), image/video generation

  (RunwayML, Kling AI, Stable Diffusion, Pika), and transcription

  (Whisper)

- Build async job queue systems (Celery / BullMQ / RQ) to manage

  concurrent video render jobs without blocking

- Integrate FFmpeg or equivalent for video stitching, subtitle burning,

  audio mixing, and format conversion

- Handle large file storage and transfer (AWS S3 or equivalent)

- Connect to YouTube Data API and other publishing platforms for

  automated or semi-automated upload



Internal Tools & Dashboards

- Build internal React/Next.js dashboards for the team to queue jobs,

  monitor pipeline status, review outputs, and manage content

- Design admin interfaces for configuring AI model parameters, prompts,

  voice profiles, and visual styles

- Build webhook/event-driven systems to connect pipeline stages



General Engineering

- Write clean, well-documented, testable Python and JavaScript/TypeScript

- Architect systems for reliability, fault tolerance, and observability

- Lead code reviews and set engineering quality standards

- Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI video generation landscape

  and propose new tools and models to integrate

- Document internal systems clearly so the team can use and maintain them



?????????????????????????????????????



REQUIREMENTS



Required:

? 5+ years of software development experience

? Strong Python skills — this is the primary backend language for

  AI/ML pipeline work (FastAPI, Django, or Flask)

? Solid JavaScript/TypeScript — Node.js services and React/Next.js

  for internal dashboards

? Hands-on experience calling and integrating AI/LLM APIs:

  OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar

? Experience building async task queues and background job systems

  (Celery, BullMQ, RQ, or equivalent)

? Comfortable working with FFmpeg or video processing pipelines

? Experience with AWS (S3, EC2, Lambda) or equivalent cloud storage

  and compute

? Solid understanding of REST API design and third-party API integration

? Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows

? Excellent written English for async, remote-first communication

? Self-directed and able to operate with high autonomy



Nice to Have (these make you stand out):

? Direct experience with AI video generation tools:

  RunwayML, Kling AI, Pika, Sora, HailuoAI, or similar

? Experience with text-to-speech APIs: ElevenLabs, Murf, or Play.ai

? Familiarity with ComfyUI or Stable Diffusion pipelines

? LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other LLM orchestration frameworks

? Whisper or other transcription/subtitle generation tools

? YouTube Data API or other publishing platform APIs

? Docker / containerization for pipeline reproducibility

? Experience building internal tools or production dashboards



?????????????????????????????????????



SETUP REQUIREMENTS



- Reliable internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps)

- Personal computer capable of running Python development environments

  and local model testing (8 GB RAM minimum; 16 GB+ preferred)

- Dedicated, quiet home workspace



?????????????????????????????????????



WORK SCHEDULE



- Flexible scheduling — deliverable and milestone based

- Core async hours aligned with Philippine Standard Time (PHT)

- Occasional overlap with US time zones for alignment calls



?????????????????????????????????????



HOW TO APPLY



We'd love to hear from you — especially if you can share examples of

AI tools, automation pipelines, or integrations you've built.

interesting automation or AI-integrated project you've shipped.

Applications submitted through the form will be prioritized.

We're built on education and honesty, not hype: no fake urgency, no constant sales gimmicks, just fast turnaround, good products, and treating customers the way we'd want to be treated.

This is a long-term position — we're not looking for a short-term contractor, we're looking for someone who wants to grow with the team over time. We just had an opening on our support team and are hiring a dedicated Customer Support VA to be the front line of that experience. Most of your day will center on our sticker printing work — tracking custom orders and keeping customers and the production team in sync — along with general customer support across the rest of the store.

Coordinate with the team through Slack and 

Handle issues the way we do: fast, honest, and fair — solving the problem in a way that builds a loyal long-term customer, not just closing the ticket

Experience with customer support tools (HubSpot, live chat, or similar)

Strong written English — you'll be communicating directly with customers all day

Reliable internet with a backup plan for outages

Comfortable working independently in a small, fast-moving team

Looking for a long-term role, not project-based or freelance work



Compensation

$6/hour to start, increasing to $7/hour after 90 days of solid performance, with yearly reviews and raises after that.



Hours

To Apply

title: Part-Time Executive / Personal Assistant – Remote
description:
I’m looking for a smart, resourceful, and highly organized Executive / Personal Assistant to help manage the many personal and business tasks that I simply don’t have time to handle myself.



This will start as a part-time, hourly role for a few hours per week, with the opportunity to grow over time.



I run multiple businesses and have a busy personal and family schedule. I’m looking for someone I can trust to take miscellaneous tasks off my plate, research solutions, coordinate details, and get things done without requiring a lot of direction.



What You’ll Do



There won't necessarily be a standard list of tasks every week. The role is about helping me save time and stay organized.



Examples may include:



Researching products, services, vendors, restaurants, activities, etc.

Comparing options and giving me a concise recommendation

Booking travel, hotels, rental cars, restaurants, and activities

Scheduling appointments and coordinating calendars

Handling reservations, cancellations, returns, refunds, and similar administrative tasks

Following up with companies or people to get information or resolve issues

Researching and purchasing gifts or other items

Helping coordinate personal and family logistics

Organizing documents, information, receipts, or records

Handling basic spreadsheets and administrative work

Researching vendors, software, or services for my businesses

Following up on miscellaneous business items

Drafting basic
s or communications

Keeping track of open items and making sure things don't fall through the cracks

Handling miscellaneous projects and problems as they come up



A lot of the job will simply be: “I need this figured out—please take care of it.”



The Person I’m Looking For



The most important thing to me is that you're smart, dependable, and resourceful.



I don't want to provide detailed step-by-step instructions for every task. I want someone who can understand what I'm trying to accomplish, research the situation, use good judgment, and move it forward independently.



You should have:



Excellent written and spoken English

Excellent communication skills

Previous Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or similar experience

Experience supporting a founder, CEO, business owner, or senior executive

Strong research and problem-solving skills

Excellent attention to detail

Good judgment and common sense

Strong organizational skills

The ability to work independently

Comfort learning new tools and figuring out unfamiliar tasks

A proactive attitude—you follow up rather than waiting to be reminded



For example, if I say:



"I want to take a three-day trip somewhere in October. Find me a few good options."



I want someone who can research destinations, flights, hotels, costs, and activities and come back with 2–3 thoughtful recommendations, rather than asking me what websites to search.



The same principle applies to business and personal tasks.



Hours & Compensation

Remote

Philippines-based

Hourly compensation

Approximately 3–5 hours per week to start

Flexible schedule for most tasks

Potential for more hours and responsibility over time

To Apply



Please send:



A brief introduction

Your previous Executive Assistant / Personal Assistant experience

Who you supported and what you handled for them

Your hourly rate

Your availability

One example of a time an executive gave you a problem or vague request and you independently figured out how to solve it



Please start your application with the word “Resourceful” so I know you read the entire posting.

description:
About the role



We run short form video campaigns for consumer brands. The content is already made and the accounts are already set up. What we need is someone reliable to get it posted every day and keep the whole thing organized.



You would own our posting operation. Around 10 to 20 accounts across TikTok, Instagram and
. Your job is to publish the videos we give you, log each post in our submission platform, and send us a short report at the end of every day.



This is not a content creation role. You will not be editing, writing captions, or coming up with ideas. All of that is handed to you. This role is about consistency, organization, and not letting anything slip.



What you would do every day



Publish scheduled videos across 10 to 20 accounts on TikTok, Instagram and

Log every post in Whop, our submission and tracking platform

Keep the posting board updated so we can see at a glance what has gone out and what is queued

Hands on experience running multiple social accounts at once. Not two or three. Ten or more.

GoLogin, GeeLark, or a similar anti detect browser or cloud phone setup. You should be comfortable working across separate profiles and know why they exist.

Scheduling tools and how to plan a posting calendar

Kanban boards for keeping work organized. We use them to track every clip through to posted.

Good enough written English to send a clear daily update



What makes someone good at this



Honestly, it is reliability. The work itself is not complicated. What is hard is doing it every single day without being reminded, catching problems early, and keeping 20 accounts straight in your head without mixing them up.



If you are the kind of person who notices that account 12 has not posted today before anyone tells you, you will do well here.



Details



Part time, roughly [ X hours per day / X hours per week ]

[ $X per month ]

Long term. We are looking for someone to grow with us as we add campaigns.

Remote, flexible hours, but posting needs to happen on schedule every day including some weekends



To apply

How many social accounts have you managed at the same time, and on which platforms?

Which anti detect browser or cloud phone tool have you used, and how many profiles did you run at once?

ds

title: Long-Form Video Editor – YouTube / Educational (Part-Time, Ongoing, Long-Term)
description:
I'm a small, established brand in the ecommerce/paid advertising education space. I publish long-form video (YouTube, educational, talking-head) and I'm looking for an editor to own that pipeline end to end: turning raw recordings into polished, well-paced videos that hold attention.



This is a long-term, ongoing relationship, not a one-off gig. Reliable editors who nail my style get steady work, more hours over time, etc.



What you'll edit



- Full long-form videos ([8–25] min) with tight cuts, remove filler/dead air, clean pacing that holds retention

- B-roll, cutaways, and screen-share woven in to support the story

- Captions/subtitles, lower-thirds, and simple on-screen text in our brand style

- Intro/outro, chapter markers, and light color + audio cleanup (levels, noise, music)

- Occasional short vertical clips pulled from the long-form video (a plus, not the main job)

- Occasional thumbnails or simple graphics (a bonus)



You're a strong fit if you:



1. Have a reel/portfolio of long-form edits I can watch (YouTube-style, not just short clips)

2. Have real taste for pacing and retention (you know how to keep a 15-minute video moving)

4. Can match an existing brand style rather than imposing your own (I'll give you a style guide and examples)

5. Are reliable with deadlines and communicate proactively about timelines

6. Turn around revisions quickly and take feedback well



Tools



- Confident in Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve for long-form editing

- Comfortable with captions/subtitles workflows

- After Effects / motion graphics is a bonus (mention it if you have it)

- Comfortable receiving large raw files via Google Drive / Dropbox / 



Requirements

1. Editing computer that can handle 1080p/4K footage

2. Reliable internet with solid upload speed (you'll need to be able to move large files)

3. ~15–20 hrs/week availability, ongoing, long-term

4. A reel or portfolio link with long-form work (required)



How to apply (read carefully)



Start your message with the word [RETENTION] so I know you read this fully. Applications without it won't be reviewed.



Link your reel/portfolio, ideally with at least one full long-form edit I can watch start to finish (a YouTube link is perfect).



Pick ONE long-form edit in your portfolio and tell me, in 2–3 sentences, how you kept it paced and where you'd have cut more (I want your thinking, not just the result).



List the editing software you use and whether you know After Effects.



Tell me your hourly rate (or per-video rate) and your typical turnaround for one [15]-minute long-form edit.



Note your internet upload speed.



I watch every reel from applicants who follow these steps and reply quickly to strong ones. Excited to see your work!
